title: Human Resources Manager
description:
WE’RE HIRING | HR MANAGER – OPERATIONS & BUSINESS PARTNERING

**Shazam Sports | Henshin Eduserv Private Limited**

**Location:**
Delhi NCR

**Experience:**
3–5 years

**Compensation:**
Up to ₹40,000 per month (all-inclusive)

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners preferred

Do You Believe Sports Can Change Lives?

At
**Shazam Sports**
, we believe sports are essential to a child's development and to building a healthier, stronger India. We are looking for an HR Manager who combines strong HR expertise with a genuine passion for sports and a desire to contribute to India's sporting future.

The Role

Own the complete HR function—from recruitment and payroll to employee engagement, compliance, and process development. Work closely with leadership and operations to build a reliable, accountable, and performance-driven workforce.

This role offers the opportunity to
**grow into a leadership position and build and lead the HR department**
as Shazam Sports expands across India.

Key Responsibilities

**1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Manage onboarding, employee documentation, confirmations, attendance, leave, HR records, and exit formalities.
* Develop and implement HR policies, SOPs, employee handbooks, and operational processes.
* Ensure timely completion of joining and separation formalities.

**2. Payroll & Compensation Management**

* Manage monthly payroll, salary calculations, incentives, reimbursements, deductions, and full-and-final settlements.
* Coordinate salary disbursements and employee salary account opening and maintenance.
* Maintain accurate salary structures, payroll records, and employee compensation data.
* Coordinate applicable statutory compliances, including PF, ESI, TDS, professional tax where applicable, and other employment-related requirements.

**3. Recruitment & Workforce Planning**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for sports trainers, operations teams, and corporate functions.
* Handle candidate sourcing, screening, interviews, salary negotiations, offers, and joining follow-ups.
* Build talent pipelines and recruitment trackers to support organisational expansion.

**4. Employee Relations & HR Business Partnering**

* Address employee grievances, workplace concerns, salary queries, and policy-related matters.
* Partner with department heads on performance management, accountability, and conflict resolution.
* Support employee engagement, retention, and a professional, performance-oriented work culture.

**5. Exit Management & Retention**

* Manage resignations, notice periods, handovers, exit interviews, clearances, and full-and-final settlements.
* Monitor attrition and identify opportunities to improve employee retention.

**6. Compliance, Reporting & Process Excellence**

* Maintain compliance records, HR documentation, and audit-ready employee files.
* Prepare monthly HR reports covering headcount, recruitment, attrition, attendance, and payroll.
* Use Excel/Google Sheets, HRMS platforms, and digital tools to improve efficiency and reporting.
* Collaborate with leadership, finance, and operations to align HR processes with business objectives.

Who Should Apply?

* 3–5 years of experience in HR operations, generalist HR, or HR business partnering.
* Strong practical knowledge of payroll, recruitment, employee lifecycle management, and statutory compliance coordination.
* Experience handling employee grievances, salary administration, onboarding, and exits.
* Strong communication, ownership, organisation, confidentiality, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently in a growing organisation and build processes from the ground up.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and familiarity with HRMS and payroll tools.
* Based in Delhi NCR and available to join immediately or at the earliest.

A Genuine Passion for Sports Is Essential

We are looking for someone who believes in the power of sports to shape children's lives and strengthen India's sporting culture. You need not be a professional athlete, but you must genuinely connect with our mission.

A Note for Serious Applicants

We are looking for committed professionals who have carefully read the job description and genuinely want to be part of the Shazam Sports journey.

**Along with your CV, please share a brief cover letter addressing these three questions:**

1. **Why sports?**
   Why do you believe sports matter in children's education and India's development?
2. **Why Shazam Sports?**
   What connects you with our mission?

Compensation & Application

**Salary:**
Up to ₹40,000 per month, all-inclusive, depending on experience and suitability.

**Location:**
Delhi NCR.

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners preferred.

Send your updated CV and cover letter to:

hans.mohan@shazamsports.in

nikhil@shazamsports.in

**Email subject:**
HR Manager Application | Your Name | Notice Period

*At Shazam Sports, we are building more than a business—we are helping shape the sporting future of the next generation. Be part of the journey.*

title: AGM/DGM - Talent Management & OD
description:
Merino Industries Limited is looking for an experienced HR professional to lead Talent Management and Organization Development initiatives, with responsibility for Learning & Development, employee induction and Employee Engagement.

This role offers an opportunity to work closely with the CHRO and business leaders to strengthen leadership pipelines, build organizational capabilities and foster a high-performance culture across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. **Strategic Talent Management and Succession Planning**

* Develop and institutionalize a company-wide talent management framework covering identification, assessment, development and deployment of talent.
* Establish a structured process for identifying high-potential employees and critical talent across functions, plants and sales.
* Lead periodic talent reviews and succession planning for critical leadership and business roles.
* Develop succession pipelines with clear readiness assessments, development actions and accountability.
* Monitor retention risks for critical talent and recommend appropriate interventions.

**2. Leadership Development**

* Design leadership competency frameworks aligned with Merino’s values, business strategy and leadership expectations.
* Develop differentiated learning journeys for emerging leaders, middle management, senior leaders and functional/technical experts.
* Implement individual development plans, executive coaching, mentoring, cross-functional projects and experiential learning.
* Evaluate leadership development effectiveness through demonstrated behavioral change, readiness for larger roles and business impact.

**3. Performance and Potential Management**

* Strengthen the performance management process through measurable objectives, goal quality, periodic reviews and consistent performance calibration.
* Facilitate performance-potential assessment and talent segmentation in partnership with business leaders and HRBPs.
* Establish development and career actions based on assessment outcomes.
* Improve managerial accountability for performance feedback, employee development and talent decisions.

**4. Career Architecture and Internal Talent Mobility**

* Develop career pathways and progression criteria for identified critical roles and job families.
* Institutionalize career conversations, internal job opportunities and cross-functional/cross-location movements.
* Identify employees suitable for expanded responsibilities, lateral development and succession opportunities.
* Promote fair, transparent and merit-based talent decisions.

**5. Organization Development and Effectiveness**

* Partner with the CHRO and business leaders on organization design, role clarity, spans and layers, decision rights and organisation effectiveness.
* Conduct organisation diagnostics, employee listening and culture assessments to identify barriers to performance.
* Facilitate change management and leadership alignment for strategic business and organisational initiatives.
* Support the evolution of a high-performance, collaborative and accountable culture.

**6. Capability Development and Learning Effectiveness**

* Identify current and future capability gaps across manufacturing, sales, supply chain, corporate functions and leadership roles.
* Develop role-based capability matrices and targeted development interventions.
* Establish appropriate measures to assess learning application, skill improvement and business impact.
* Partner with internal subject-matter experts and external institutions to deliver relevant development programmes.

**7. Talent Analytics and Governance**

* Establish dashboards covering succession depth, talent readiness, internal fill rates, HiPo retention, development progress and critical talent risks.
* Present periodic talent and organisation effectiveness reviews to the CHRO and leadership team.
* Ensure consistency, confidentiality, fairness and data integrity in talent assessment and succession decisions.
* Continuously benchmark relevant practices and improve processes based on organisational needs and business outcomes.

title: Head of Human Resources (HR & Administration)
description:
**Title: Head of HR**

**Location: Noida**

**Qualifications:**

* **MBA in Human Resources or a related discipline preferred.**
* **Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a relevant field.**

**Experience:**

* **13-20 years of progressive experience in Human Resources, including significant experience in senior HR leadership roles.**
* **Proven track record of developing and implementing HR strategies, policies, and organizational development initiatives.**
* **Experience in leading teams and partnering with senior leadership on strategic business decisions.**
* **Ex-Defence / Military personnel with relevant experience in HR, personnel management, administration, or organizational leadership will be strongly preferred.**

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced and strategic
**Head of HR**
to lead the organization's Human Resources and Administration functions. The incumbent will act as a strategic business partner to senior leadership, driving people strategy, organizational development, talent management, employee engagement, and operational excellence.

The role requires a strong leader with extensive HR experience, sound knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance, and the ability to build a high-performance, inclusive, and employee-centric workplace culture. Candidates with a Defence/Military background and relevant experience in personnel management, administration, discipline, and organizational leadership will be strongly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic HR Leadership:**

* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with business objectives and organizational growth plans.
* Partner with senior management on workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, and change management.
* Establish HR policies, processes, and governance frameworks to enhance organizational effectiveness.
* Drive strategic HR initiatives that improve employee productivity, retention, and overall business performance.

**Talent Acquisition & Onboarding:**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment and selection strategies across functions and organizational levels.
* Ensure effective manpower planning and timely fulfilment of critical positions.
* Develop structured onboarding and induction programs to facilitate employee integration and faster productivity.
* Strengthen employer branding and talent pipelines to attract and retain high-quality professionals.

**Performance Management & Talent Development:**

* Design and implement performance appraisal systems, KPIs, and competency frameworks.
* Identify high-potential employees and develop succession and career progression plans.
* Establish learning and development initiatives to enhance employee capabilities and leadership effectiveness.
* Drive a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence.

**Employee Engagement & Organizational Culture:**

* Develop initiatives to improve employee engagement, motivation, retention, and workplace satisfaction.
* Promote a culture of integrity, collaboration, transparency, and mutual respect.
* Conduct employee feedback exercises, engagement surveys, and retention analysis.
* Strengthen internal communication and organizational alignment.

**Labour Law Compliance & Industrial Relations:**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour laws, statutory regulations, and employment requirements.
* Oversee HR audits, statutory documentation, policy reviews, and compliance reporting.
* Manage industrial relations, employee grievances, disciplinary matters, and workplace investigations.
* Identify employment-related risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

**Employee Relations & Conflict Resolution:**

* Act as a trusted advisor and mediator in complex employee relations matters.
* Resolve workplace conflicts and grievances objectively, fairly, and confidentially.
* Lead disciplinary proceedings and investigations in accordance with company policies and applicable laws.
* Ensure consistent application of HR policies and promote procedural fairness.

**Compensation, Benefits & Rewards:**

* Develop and review compensation structures, incentive plans, and employee benefit programs.
* Conduct salary benchmarking and support compensation decisions in line with market practices and company budgets.
* Design recognition and retention initiatives to attract and retain key talent.
* Ensure consistency, transparency, and internal equity in reward practices.

**HR Operations, Administration & Analytics:**

* Oversee HR operations, employee records, payroll coordination, attendance, leave management, and employee lifecycle processes.
* Lead, mentor, and develop the HR and Administration team.
* Leverage HRIS, dashboards, and people analytics to monitor workforce trends and support data-driven decisions.
* Establish HR metrics covering recruitment, attrition, engagement, performance, and workforce productivity.
* Drive process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across HR and Administration.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* **MBA in Human Resources or a related discipline preferred.**
* **Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, or a relevant field.**
* **Professional certifications such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, SPHR, CIPD, or Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) will be an added advantage.**
* **13-20 years of progressive experience in Human Resources, including significant experience in senior HR leadership roles.**
* **Proven track record of developing and implementing HR strategies, policies, and organizational development initiatives.**
* **Strong practical knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory compliance, employee relations, and HR governance.**
* **Demonstrated experience in managing recruitment, performance management, compensation, employee engagement, and HR operations.**
* **Experience in leading teams and partnering with senior leadership on strategic business decisions.**
* **Ex-Defence / Military personnel with relevant experience in HR, personnel management, administration, or organizational leadership will be strongly preferred.**

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking and business partnering
* Leadership and team management
* Manpower planning and talent management
* Indian labour law and statutory compliance
* Industrial relations and employee grievance management
* Conflict resolution, negotiation, and mediation
* Performance management and succession planning
* HR analytics, HRIS, and process improvement
* Change management and organizational development
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and decision-making skills

title: Director, People Data and Reporting
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Metrics & Reporting**

* Own the global people metrics catalogue: definitions, calculation logic, and ownership for headcount, attrition, hiring, mobility, diversity, and related measures.
* Lead the move from custom report requests to self-serve reporting, rationalising legacy reports into a small set of governed master reports with role-based access.
* Own management and executive reporting for People & Culture leadership, the Senior Leadership Team, and Finance, on a consistent monthly and quarterly cadence.
* Define the reporting dimensions that must hold across every layer: organisation structure, job classification, location, supervisory hierarchy, and grade.
* Ensure historical trends survive organisation restructures and employee ID changes.
* Put export guardrails and access controls in place, reducing reliance on uncontrolled data extracts.

**Data Governance & Quality**

* Establish and run the people data governance framework: decision rights, data ownership, stewardship, and a clear RACI across People Analytics, HR process owners, IT, and Finance.
* Own the semantic layer standards and data dictionary for people data.
* Lead monthly headcount reconciliation with Finance and resolve differences between HR and Finance figures at source.
* Build a data quality programme with measurable rules, scorecards, root-cause fixes, and accountable owners in the HR process teams.
* Work with Data Protection and Legal on GDPR and local privacy requirements, including access, retention, and cross-border data use.
* Maintain documentation, lineage, and change control for reports, metrics, and data pipelines.

**Leadership and partnership**

* Lead and develop a distributed team across both functions, setting clear priorities and standards.
* Act as the senior counterpart to HRIS, IT data engineering, and Finance on reporting and data decisions, including HRIS programme milestones.
* Prioritise demand transparently and say no to requests that duplicate governed reporting.
* Partner with the Analytics and AI teams so advanced analytics builds on governed, reusable data rather than one-off extracts.
* Build a regular interlock with business and functional leaders to understand their decisions, agree the measures that matter, and turn governed reporting into insight.

**What You'll Bring**

* [15+] years in people analytics, HR reporting, workforce data, or enterprise data management, with at least [5] years leading teams.
* Global ownership of HR or workforce reporting in a large multinational, ideally at 50,000+ employees.
* Proven delivery of a data governance framework: decision rights, stewardship, data dictionaries, and data quality measurement.
* Hands-on understanding of HR data models, including organisation hierarchies, effective dating, and handling restructures without breaking trends.
* Strong experience with SAP SuccessFactors reporting, plus a data lake or warehouse and a BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
* Experience working with SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and Snowflake.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including data engineering, lakehouse, and semantic models.
* Proven ability to work through disparate data sets from HR, Finance, and other enterprise systems, and bring them into a single, governed semantic layer.
* Strong business interlock: experience partnering with business and functional leaders to frame questions, agree measures, and turn reporting into insight that drives decisions.
* Experience reconciling workforce data with Finance, including headcount and cost definitions.
* Track record of rationalising a report estate and moving users to self-serve.
* Working knowledge of GDPR and data protection requirements for employee data.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders in HR, IT, and Finance, and to hold a line on standards.
* Experience leading distributed teams across regions and time zones.
* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, information systems, or business discipline.

Nice to have
  
  

* Master's degree in analytics, information management, or an MBA.
* Data governance certification such as DAMA CDMP, or familiarity with DAMA-DMBOK.
* Experience with an HRIS migration or consolidation, including post-merger integration.
* Experience with data catalogue or lineage tools such as Collibra, Alation, or Microsoft Purview.
* SQL skills and familiarity with semantic modelling in Power BI or similar.
* Experience defining metrics to external standards such as ISO 30414.
* Experience working with works councils on employee data use.

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working

description:

: 1–3 years

**About the Company**

TheHireHub.AI provides AI-powered recruitment automation that sources, screens, and schedules candidates for hiring teams. Its platform is designed for mid-market teams and also supports executive and high-growth employers across varied hiring needs, including recruitment across more than 45 countries. Headquartered in Gurugram, India, the company works at the intersection of software development and staffing and recruiting. Its technology brings key stages of the recruitment workflow together, helping employers coordinate candidate discovery, evaluation, and scheduling. The business serves organizations with different hiring requirements, from mid-market recruitment needs to executive and high-growth hiring. This combination of technology and recruitment operations gives TheHireHub.AI a practical view of how hiring processes can be managed across geographies. Its work centers on making sourcing, screening, and scheduling part of a more coordinated recruitment experience for hiring teams.

**About the Role**

TheHireHub.AI is seeking a people-focused HR professional to help shape how employees join, connect, and grow with the business. Reporting to the Founder, you’ll lead end-to-end recruitment while supporting employee engagement, HR policies, onboarding, and employee relations. You’ll also help coordinate performance and feedback cycles, internal communications, and company events. The team is energetic and eager to grow and learn, so this role suits someone who takes initiative and adapts as priorities evolve. This is a full-time, on-site opportunity in Noida or Gurugram for someone with one to three years of experience. It offers autonomy and broad business exposure in a startup environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead recruitment from start to finish, coordinating candidates and hiring stakeholders throughout the process. Keep hiring activity organized and responsive to the company’s needs.
* Develop employee engagement initiatives that encourage connection and participation. Listen to employee perspectives and use them to shape relevant activities.
* Create and maintain HR policies and people operations practices. Make guidance clear and accessible so employees can understand the support and expectations available to them.
* Manage onboarding and orientation for new hires. Coordinate the information and activities that help people settle in and understand their responsibilities.
* Respond to employee questions and concerns with care and professionalism. Build rapport and support constructive employee relations across the organization.
* Support performance and feedback cycles by coordinating process steps and communications. Help employees and managers stay informed about expectations and follow-up.
* Coordinate internal communications and events, sharing timely information and creating opportunities for employees to participate.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Hands-on talent acquisition and recruitment experience, including the ability to coordinate end-to-end hiring activity. Bring structure and reliable follow-through to candidate and stakeholder communication.
* Knowledge of employee engagement and people operations practices. Use this foundation to support initiatives that contribute to a positive employee experience.
* Ability to create, maintain, and communicate HR policies. Express workplace guidance clearly and consistently so employees can understand and use it.
* Experience coordinating onboarding and orientation. Manage relevant details and communications so new employees receive the information they need as they join.
* Employee relations capability, including thoughtful responses to employee questions and concerns. Build rapport and handle sensitive conversations with discretion.
* Clear communication and strong interpersonal skills. Share information directly and considerately while working with employees and stakeholders.
* Adaptability and organization across varied HR responsibilities. Shift between recruitment, employee support, and people operations while maintaining dependable follow-through.

**Additional Plus**

* Exposure to performance and feedback cycles, internal communications, or employee events is useful. Be ready to coordinate these processes and activities as needed.
* Familiarity with startup pace and changing priorities can help you contribute across a broad range of people operations needs.

**What You'll Bring**

* One to three years of relevant experience in human resources, talent acquisition, recruitment, employee engagement, or people operations.
* A people-focused approach and the interpersonal skills to build rapport and respond constructively to employee questions and concerns.
* Strong communication skills in English, along with adaptability to handle varied responsibilities and changing priorities.
* An organized, dependable working style and readiness to support recruitment, onboarding, HR policies, engagement, and employee experience.

**Why Join Us**

At TheHireHub.AI, people operations sits alongside a business building AI-powered recruitment automation for hiring teams. The company’s platform supports sourcing, screening, and candidate scheduling for mid-market teams, as well as executive and high-growth employers. You’ll see how people priorities connect with recruitment work in a technology-led business. Reporting directly to the Founder, you’ll have room to take ownership across hiring, engagement, policies, onboarding, employee relations, and internal communications rather than being limited to one narrow area. The team is motivated to grow and learn, creating an environment where curiosity and initiative matter. This is a practical opportunity to build experience by helping employees feel welcomed, supported, and informed, while contributing to the company’s hiring needs. A startup setting brings broad business exposure, and the role offers autonomy across day-to-day people operations and employee experience. The work is full-time and on-site in Noida or Gurugram, with a varied remit for someone ready to learn, contribute, and adapt as priorities shift.

**What We Offer**

* A startup environment with scope to contribute across recruitment, people operations, and employee experience priorities.
* Autonomy in a broad role, with direct reporting to the Founder and exposure to business needs across the organization.
* A full-time, on-site opportunity in Noida or Gurugram, supporting hiring and employee experience in an AI-powered recruitment business.

title: HR Specialist
description:
Join us at Orange Business!
  
  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.
  
  
**About The Role**
The role of the HR Specialist is responsible to provide end to end Payroll processing support for India and other APAC countries as per business needs. Ensure zero error in payroll inputs and support all areas of HR Operations including payroll and benefits. Primary focus on India Payroll and Benefits.
  
  
**About You**
Key Activities for the role:
  
  
**New Hire**

* Validate the NHF for one-time payments, such as joining bonuses, referral payments, and notice-period payments.
* Validate nominations for PF (Forms 2 and 11), gratuity (Form F), and term life cover.

**Payroll Processing**

* Validate and upload new-hire data from Personal File folders and PIMS.
* Validate payroll inputs received from the HRSSC team.
* Prepare payroll inputs for M1-HR.
* Compile flexible benefits inputs.
* Process one-time inputs, including crèche benefit, Sodexo Meal Card, NPS, VPF, LOP, insurance premium deductions, and other payments or deductions.
* Validate salary revision inputs.
* Upload payroll inputs to the Excelity portal in line with the monthly payroll calendar.
* Share Form 11 data for new hires with the Dayforce payroll vendor for PF challan processing.
* Respond to new-hire queries about investment declarations and planners.
* Handle post-payroll queries relating to income tax and other payroll deductions.

**Gratuity Settlement**

* Prepare gratuity payment data for Full and Final (F&F) cases.
* Validate last-drawn basic salary, tenure, and eligibility under the company’s gratuity policy.
* Prepare policy-wise settlement letters, obtain authorization, and send them to LIC.

**Full and Final Settlement**

* Process F&F settlements for resigned employees.
* Handle former-employee queries about F&F calculations, experience letters, and Form 16.
* Follow up on F&F recovery cases and coordinate closure with Finance.

**Invoice Processing**

* Receive and validate invoices from HR vendors and confirm them to Finance for processing.
* Manage purchase requisitions (PRs) and invoices end to end.
* Request advance purchase orders (POs) through HRSSC where required.
* Maintain an invoice tracker and serve as the primary contact for vendors regarding invoice settlement.

**Insurance Support**

* Validate data for entity transfers and coordinate with the insurer to maintain continuity of employee benefits.
* Reconcile employee and dependent details for GMC, GTL, and GPA endorsements.
* Provide 24/7 support during medical emergencies, including issuing medical e-cards and sharing policy details.
* Coordinate with Finance on CD invoice processing.
* Notify Medi Assist of life events requiring dependent additions, such as a newborn or a spouse following marriage.
* Support employee coverage data for new hires and policy renewals.

**NPS Benefit Support**

* Assist employees with opening NPS accounts or moving to the NPS Corporate Scheme.
* Upload NPS contribution files to the HDFC portal and share payment advice with Finance.
* Maintain a tracker of accounts mapped to the NPS Corporate Scheme.

**Sodexo Benefit Support**

* Prepare Sodexo files for upload and payment.
* Investigate missing credits caused by pending KYC.
* Follow up with the vendor on physical card dispatches.
* Request renewals for expired cards and distribute physical cards to employees.
* Maintain and update the physical card tracker.

**Car Lease (Day-to-Day Support)**

* Advise employees on policy benefits and eligibility.
* Assist with documentation, EMI deductions, and recordkeeping.

**Bonus Reconciliation**

* Reconcile bonus data for payment processing.

**PF Query Support**

* Assist employees with PF transfer and withdrawal queries.
* Support manual UAN creation for former employees who joined before 2014.
* Assist current and former employees with JD corrections.
* Provide documentation support for EPFO death-claim cases.

**Statutory Audit Support**

* Provide payroll and other data for statutory audits and actuarial valuations, supporting internal and external audits.

**Employee Queries**

* Manage employee and AskHR queries and support benefits processing and documentation.

**Employment Letters**

* Prepare employment-related letters, including service certificates for former employees, physical letters upon request, and project deployment letters.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
  
  
Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
  
  
Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
  
  
Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
  
  
Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
  
  
Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.
  
  
**Only Your Skills Matter**
Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neurotype, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: Recruitment Specialist
description:
**Job Description**

**Title:**

Recruitment Specialist

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

**Department:**

Human Resources

**Experience required:**

5+ years

**Working mode:**

In-office (on-site)

**Location:**

Sector 53, Gurgaon

**Industry:**

Service-based

**Salary:**

Best in industry

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a sharp, dynamic, and highly organised HR professional who knows how to find great talent, keep things running smoothly, and make HR smarter with technology.

You should be a recruitment enthusiast with a keen eye for detail, a proactive mindset, and the ability to juggle multiple priorities without losing track of the little things. You must be adaptable, resourceful, and comfortable navigating a fast-paced work environment.

Most importantly, you must believe in working smarter, not harder. You will be actively exploring AI tools, automation, and technology to streamline HR processes, improve productivity, and deliver better results.

If you’re someone who takes ownership, learns quickly, thinks on your feet, and turns challenges into opportunities, we’d love to meet you!

**Key Responsibilities**

**~Talent Acquisition & Recruitment**

* Own the end-to-end recruitment cycle, from understanding hiring requirements to sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates.
* Develop creative sourcing strategies to attract high-quality talent through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and other relevant channels.
* Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support current and future hiring needs.
* Coordinate with hiring managers to understand role requirements, hiring priorities, and timelines.
* Ensure timely follow-ups with candidates and hiring managers, delivering a smooth and professional candidate experience.
* Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-hire, source effectiveness, and offer-to-joining ratios.

**~HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Manage HR documentation, employee records, onboarding, induction, and exit formalities with accuracy and efficiency.
* Maintain organised employee databases, trackers, HR dashboards, and reports.
* Support attendance, leave management, employee queries, and other day-to-day HR operations.
* Ensure HR records and processes are maintained consistently and confidentially.
* Assist in developing and improving HR policies, processes, and standard operating procedures.

**~AI, Automation & Technology**

* Make maximum practical use of AI tools to improve recruitment efficiency and automate repetitive HR tasks.
* Leverage AI for job descriptions, candidate outreach, interview question development, resume analysis, HR communication, reporting, and process documentation.
* Explore new HR technologies, automation tools, and productivity platforms to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Use tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, ATS platforms, and other relevant applications effectively.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, fairness, confidentiality, and relevance before using them in HR decisions or communications.
* Develop smarter workflows that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround time, and enhance the employee experience.

**~Employee Engagement & People Support**

* Support employee engagement initiatives, celebrations, recognition programmes, and internal communication.
* Assist in organising employee activities, onboarding experiences, and culture-building initiatives.
* Act as a responsive point of contact for employee queries and routine HR support.
* Contribute ideas that strengthen employee experience, collaboration, and workplace culture.

**~Organisation, Reporting & Process Improvement**

* Maintain accurate trackers, recruitment pipelines, calendars, documentation, and task lists.
* Manage multiple assignments simultaneously while prioritising deadlines and business requirements.
* Prepare regular recruitment and HR reports to support data-driven decision-making.
* Identify gaps in existing processes and proactively recommend practical solutions.
* Take complete ownership of assigned tasks and ensure timely closure without constant follow-ups.

**What We're Looking For**

* A Recruitment Pro: Strong understanding of sourcing, screening, candidate management, and end-to-end recruitment.
* Tech-Savvy & AI-Driven: Comfortable with digital tools and enthusiastic about using AI and automation to work more efficiently.
* Sharp & Analytical: Able to understand requirements quickly, ask the right questions, and make sound decisions.
* Detail-Oriented: Maintains accuracy in documentation, data, communication, and follow-ups.
* Highly Organised: Good at managing multiple priorities, keeping track of details, and meeting deadlines.
* Adaptable & Dynamic: Comfortable with changing requirements and a fast-moving work environment.
* A Self-Starter: Takes initiative, solves problems independently, and follows through on commitments.
* A Continuous Learner: Curious, open to feedback, and always looking for better ways to work.
* A Strong Communicator: Communicates professionally and confidently with candidates, employees, and stakeholders.
* A Team Player: Collaborative, approachable, dependable, and committed to getting things done.

**Preferred Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in HR, with strong hands-on recruitment experience.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel, Google Workspace, LinkedIn, job portals, and HR tools.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Gemini for professional tasks.
* Experience with ATS platforms, recruitment dashboards, and workflow automation is an advantage.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Positions are filled efficiently with the right-quality candidates.
* Recruitment pipelines and HR records remain accurate and up to date.
* HR tasks are completed on time, with minimal errors and follow-up.
* AI and automation are actively used to improve productivity and reduce repetitive work.
* Employees and candidates receive a positive, responsive HR experience.
* Processes become more streamlined, organised, and scalable over time.

**The Ideal Candidate**

We’re not just looking for someone who completes HR tasks. We’re looking for someone who owns the process, spots the details others miss, embraces technology, and constantly finds smarter ways to get things done.

You should be equally comfortable finding the right candidate, managing HR operations, building a tracker, experimenting with an AI tool, and handling an unexpected priority; all while keeping things organised and moving forward.

If you’re proactive, curious, resourceful, and ready to make a real impact, this role is for you!

title: Human Resources Business Partner
company: Global Access to Talent from India (GATI) Foundation
description:
**Position: HR Business Partner**

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**About GATI Foundation**

Global Access to Talent from India (GATI) is a mission-driven organization working to position India as the world's most trusted source of global talent. GATI partners with governments, industry, international employers, training institutions, and ecosystem stakeholders to build sustainable global workforce pathways, strengthen international labour mobility, and create high-quality overseas employment opportunities for Indian talent. Through strategic partnerships, policy engagement, and program implementation, GATI works to strengthen India's global workforce mobility ecosystem.

**Position Summary**

As the organisation's first HR Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in building its people function and shaping its culture as it grows. Working closely with the leadership team and in partnership with The Converge Foundation (TCF) 's Talent Strategy team, you will establish foundational people practices, strengthen organisational effectiveness, and build systems that enable the organisation to attract, develop and retain talent.

This role calls for a hands-on, solution-oriented professional who can navigate ambiguity, exercise sound judgement and build fit-for-purpose people systems in an evolving, mission-driven organisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Culture, Engagement & Employee Experience**

* Partner with leadership to shape and nurture an organisational culture aligned with the organisation's mission, values and ways of working.
* Design and drive employee engagement initiatives that foster trust, collaboration, inclusion and a strong sense of purpose.
* Establish regular feedback mechanisms to understand employee experiences, identify emerging concerns and translate insights into actionable interventions.
* Facilitate effective communication and change management to strengthen alignment between leadership and teams.
* Build a positive employee experience across key moments in the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to exit.

**2. Employee Relations & Grievance Management**

* Serve as the first point of contact for employees on workplace concerns, interpersonal challenges and grievances, ensuring timely, fair and confidential resolution.
* Partner with leadership to address sensitive employee matters, navigate difficult conversations and resolve conflicts constructively.
* Ensure appropriate escalation and handling of sensitive matters, including those requiring formal investigation or specialist support.

**3. People Policies, Processes & Governance**

* Develop and institutionalise foundational HR policies, processes and guidelines suited to the organisation's stage of growth, size and operating context.
* Drive adoption and consistent implementation of people policies across the organisation, reviewing and refining them as the organisation evolves.
* Ensure policies and processes comply with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, in coordination with relevant internal or external experts.

**4. Talent Management & Organisational Effectiveness**

* Partner with leadership to identify current and future talent needs and build a people plan aligned with organisational priorities.
* Drive key talent management processes, including goal-setting, performance management, feedback, development planning, career progression and retention.
* Work with managers to strengthen people leadership capabilities, including role clarity, performance conversations, team management and employee development.
* Support organisational design, role definition, reporting structures and decision-making clarity as the organisation grows.
* Identify talent risks, capability gaps and succession needs, and work with leadership to develop appropriate interventions.

**5. Partnership with Leadership & TCF Talent Strategy**

* Act as a trusted thought partner to the organisation's leadership on people, culture, talent and organisational effectiveness matters.
* Translate organisational priorities into actionable people strategies and interventions, balancing immediate needs with long-term institution-building.
* Work closely with TCF's Talent Strategy team to leverage expertise, frameworks and resources, and adapt relevant practices to the organisation's context.
* Collaborate with TCF's Talent Strategy team on key people initiatives, seeking guidance and support where needed while building the organisation's internal HR ownership and capability.
* Share insights on emerging people trends, risks and organisational challenges with leadership and TCF, enabling informed decision-making.

**Desired Qualifications, Skills and Abilities**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier institution in human resources or a related field.
* 3-5 years of relevant work experience in the HR/people function
* Excellent networking and relationship-building skills, with the ability to recognise, inspire, and connect with best-in-class talent.
* Excellent presentation and Excel skills, with the ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with external audiences.
* Strong executional skills and the ability to deliver within timelines and meet deadlines.
* Ability to be effective in a fast-paced, consensus-based work environment.

**Personal Characteristics and Desired Qualities**

**Building Relationships**

Thrives on building strong networks and nurturing relationships with high-quality talent in the corporate and social sectors, and wants to work with top leaders in system-change organisations to help build them from the ground up.

**Proactiveness**

Highly motivated and able to work independently toward agreed goals and targets, taking ownership of the overall HR strategy and process of the portfolio.

**Problem Solving**

Able to problem-solve quickly when needed, balancing multiple perspectives while addressing challenges.

**Collaboration**

High ability to collaborate and actively listen to others, understanding and valuing their views. Ability to manage multiple high-volume roles simultaneously.

Demonstrates sensitivity, confidentiality, and discretion in interactions and engagement with prospective and active candidates, beyond the recruitment process.

**Compensation**

Remuneration will be competitive with Indian philanthropy pay scales and will depend on the candidate's experience.

**Location**

New Delhi, India

title: Human Resources Specialist
company: ICARDA; International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas
description:
**Reports to:**
Human Resources Manager with matrix reporting to Country Coordinator
**Location:**
New Delhi, India
  
  
**Purpose of the position**
The incumbent to this role provides specialized HR support to assigned country office(s), contributing to the effective implementation of HR policies, processes and services across the employee lifecycle. The position provides advice and guidance to managers and staff on established HR policies and procedures, analyses routine and moderately complex HR matters, and makes qualified recommendations to the Human Resources Manager where further consideration is required.
  
  
The role supports the consistent delivery of HR services across recruitment, employee relations, HR operations, performance management, learning and staff engagement, while maintaining accurate HR information and records and ensuring appropriate follow-up on HR actions.
  
  
**About ICARDA**
The International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) is a treaty-based international non-profit research organization supported by CGIAR.
  
  
ICARDA's mission is to reduce poverty, enhance food, water, and nutritional security, as well as environmental health in the face of global challenges including climate change. We do this through innovative science, strategic partnerships, linking research to development and capacity development that take into account gender equality and the role of youth in transforming the dry areas. ICARDA works in partnership with governments, universities, civil society, national agricultural research organization, other CGIAR Research Centers, and the private sector. With its temporary Headquarters in Beirut, Lebanon, ICARDA operates in regional and country offices across Africa, Asia and the Middle East. For more information: www.icarda.org.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Main responsibilities**
**HR Advisory & Employee Relations**

* Provide day-to-day HR advice and guidance to managers and staff on established HR policies, procedures and employee lifecycle matters
* Respond to staff queries and provide clarification on HR processes and requirements
* Review employee relations matters, undertake appropriate fact-finding and provide initial analysis and recommendations to the HR Manager
* Support the consistent application of HR practices across assigned offices and identify matters requiring escalation
* Maintain confidentiality and appropriate records relating to employee matters

**Recruitment & Onboarding**

* Coordinate recruitment processes for regular positions and complementary resources in accordance with established procedures
* Support hiring managers with job descriptions, recruitment documentation, interview arrangements and selection processes
* Coordinate candidate communications, approvals and recruitment records
* Process requests relating to consultancy and other complementary resource engagements in accordance with the guidelines established
* Coordinate onboarding and induction activities, including HRIS inputs and employee documentation

**HR Policy Implementation & Compliance**

* Support the implementation and consistent application of ICARDA HR policies, procedures and guidelines
* Interpret established HR guidelines and apply them to routine and defined operational cases
* Identify HR and employment compliance issues and bring matters requiring further review to the attention of the HR Manager
* Support HR audits, compliance reviews and implementation of policy updates
* Prepare information and documentation required for HR reviews and management consideration

**HR Operations, Data & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and HRIS information
* Process routine HR transactions and follow established procedures for employee-related actions
* Coordinate HR inputs required for payroll and other employee-related processes
* Maintain HR trackers and prepare standard HR reports, workforce data and management summaries
* Monitor data quality and follow up on outstanding HR actions and documentation
* Analyse HR data and information to identify trends, discrepancies or issues requiring management attention

**Performance, Learning & Staff Development**

* Support implementation of the performance management process, including communication, documentation, timelines and follow-up
* Provide guidance to staff and managers on established performance management procedures
* Support identification of training and development needs and contribute to learning priorities
* Coordinate approved learning and development activities, including logistics, communications and records
* Maintain relevant learning and performance management records

**Staff Engagement & Separations**

* Support staff engagement activities and HR communications across assigned offices
* Respond to HR queries and identify recurring issues for consideration by the HR Manager
* Support implementation of staff engagement initiatives and related HR activities
* Coordinate exit interviews and separation processes in accordance with established procedures
* Ensure timely completion of separation documentation and related HR requirements

**HR Process Improvement & Coordination**

* Identify operational issues in HR processes and recommend practical improvements to the HR Manager
* Support HR digitalization and process improvement initiatives
* Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, IT, Facilities, Security and other functions on employee-related matters
* Liaise with external service providers on routine HR operational matters
* Prepare HR reports, presentations and briefing materials as required
* Undertake other related HR responsibilities assigned by the supervisor

**Requirements**
**Education, Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Personnel Management, Business Administration, Industrial Psychology or a related discipline
* A relevant professional HR qualification or certification would be an advantage
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in an international, multicultural or development organization
* Practical experience in HR operations, recruitment, employee relations, policy implementation and employee lifecycle processes
* Good knowledge of HR policies, procedures and practices, with the ability to interpret and apply established guidelines
* Experience working with HR information systems and ERP systems, with good data management and reporting skills
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to review information, identify issues and make qualified recommendations
* Good interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with managers, staff and service providers
* Excellent written and spoken English
* High level of integrity and ability to maintain confidentiality
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

**Benefits**
**Terms of appointment, salary, and benefits**
This position will be based at the ICARDA Delhi Office in India and may only be filled by permanent citizens of India. ICARDA offers an attractive compensation package including a competitive salary, medical insurance, 30 days of annual leave, maternity leave and paternity leave. The successful candidate will be offered an initial contract of 3 years, renewable subject to continued need for the position and satisfactory performance.
  
  
**Please be advised that ICARDA accepts applications only in English, as per the organization's standard communication language. Applications in other languages will not be considered.**
**Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.**

title: Lead – People, Culture, Policies
description:
Title: Lead – People, Culture, Policies

No. of positions - 1

Location: Delhi, India (with regular travel to other state offices)

Breakthrough is looking for a people-leader who believes building organisation is quite akin to building its people and loves problem solving with HR as their strategy of choice, to join us as the Lead: people, culture, policies and steer the Human Resources vertical with strategic insights and direction. This is a full-time role based out of Delhi with travels to field offices, as needed.

Breakthrough has a large programme reaching out to 100,000 adolescents and about 12,000 youth directly in Haryana, Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Jharkhand at any given point in time, as well as over 3 million more adolescents through school systems in Punjab and Odisha. We are almost a 300 member organisation and the growth curve is steep. Breakthrough has always been an organisation that keeps values at the centre. Our challenge is to balance Breakthrough’s humans remaining inspired and Breakthrough constantly delivering on cutting edge work.

We, at Breakthrough, are keenly aware of the large scope and strategic importance of this role and hope to find an able, experienced, and passionate leader who would keep organising the human elements by keeping the strategic direction of the organisation in focus, and build HR of Breakthrough keeping the future course of action at the centre. Given that passionate people are at the centre of Breakthrough, we would encourage you to apply if you are a people’s person and thrive in human interaction with deep interest in the messy beauty of it.

We have a fully functional HR team which is able and tuned into the current needs and aspirations of the HR in Breakthrough, we need a strategic leader, with a passion to build the future. It is a senior position will be hired at the Director level and report to the CEO.

Key Responsibilities:

* Ensure alignment and coordination between national and state-level HR teams. Build and re-align where needed.
* Develop decentralized talent management mechanisms
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and retention strategies for national and state office staff. Support leaders in troubleshooting.
* Establish standardized recruitment and performance management frameworks while allowing state-level adaptation. Build ways to capture diversity.
* Support succession planning and leadership development at national and state levels.
* Be accountable for the organizational culture and promote a unified organizational culture rooted in Breakthrough’s values across all state offices.
* Provide guidance and escalation support for complex employee relations cases arising at the state level as well as national office. Help in taking timely decisions.
* Lead staff engagement, wellbeing, care initiatives across geographically dispersed teams.

**HR Operations & Legal Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with national labor legislation and varying state labor laws and regulations.
* Develop, update, and enforce HR policies, procedures, employee handbook, and code of conduct for nationwide use.
* Oversee compensation, benefits, payroll coordination, and HR information systems across multiple locations.
* Safeguarding, Ethics & Risk Management
* Lead safeguarding, POSH, anti-harassment, and whistleblowing mechanisms across all offices.
* Ensure consistent implementation of safeguarding policies and mandatory staff training nationwide.
* Serve as a focal point for sensitive cases, ensuring confidentiality, consistency, and legal compliance.

**Capacity Building & HR Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and build the capacity of HR staff at national and state offices.
* Conduct regular HR reviews, audits, and capacity assessments at state offices.
* Promote knowledge sharing and best practices across locations.
* Manage budgets. Work on budgeting, systems of reporting
* Develop and manage the national HR budget, including allocations for state offices.
* Track HR metrics and workforce data across states and provide regular reports to senior management and the Board.
* Strengthen HR systems to support multi-location operations and data consistency.

**Qualifications & Experience Required:**

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or a related field.
* Minimum of 15-20 years of progressive HR experience, including senior leadership in a multi-location organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing HR functions across multiple states or regions.
* Strong knowledge of national and state labor laws and compliance requirements.
* Prior experience in the NGO or non-profit sector is strongly preferred.

**Skills & Competencies Required:**

* Proven ability to lead and coordinate decentralized teams.
* Independent decision making ability.
* Strong policy development and compliance management skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution abilities.
* High cultural sensitivity and ability to work effectively across diverse regions.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* A solution mindset.

**Values & Commitment:**

* Strong alignment with the Breakthrough’s mission and impact objectives.
* Value alignment with the core values of Breakthrough.
* Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, safeguarding, and ethical practice.

**About Breakthrough:**

Breakthrough works on culture change by shifting social norms that limit women and girls from reaching their full potential. We work with adolescents and young people aged 11-25 years aiming for an entire generation to shift and push for change. Over time, we have worked with more than 5.4 million adolescents and young people, aged 11 to 25, to encourage aspiration, agency, leadership and negotiation through our work in schools and communities. We also support them with media tools that shape public narratives. This has resulted in a generation of young people shifting to think and act in confident, intentional ways. Girls are negotiating to stay in school, delaying marriage, exercising choices around life goals, stepping into non-traditional career paths. Boys are stepping up to contribute, support and uphold equal rights for all. This gives hope that a more equal world is possible for future generations.

**Breakthrough’s Culture:**

Employees at Breakthrough are expected to work in line with organisational values of Dignity, Integrity and Equity. Breakthrough is an equal opportunity employer. We consider applicants for all positions without regard to race, colour, caste, religion, creed, gender, age, disability, economic status, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. We prefer people from marginalised communities, women and other genders. Our policies and procedures reflect our commitment towards child safeguarding. Breakthrough is committed to the well-being of its employees and understands an individual’s mental health can impact their ability to work. Breakthrough recognizes taking steps to improve mental health and wellbeing of the employees is essential. We are committed to fostering an environment that promotes employee wellbeing. We recognize that well-being is not just the absence of illness, but the presence of factors that support a fulfilling life.

To know more about Breakthrough, please visit – www.inbreakthrough.org

Eligible candidates interested in this position may apply through the following link: https://www.btconnect.org.in/Applicant/CreateJobApplicant

Please select Director - People, Culture, Policies for the position applied from drop down menu.

You can also submit your resume accompanied by a cover letter by email to jobs@inbreakthrough.org by 10th Nov 2026.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Purpose**

The Human Resources Manager will be responsible for leading and overseeing end-to-end HR operations while fostering a high-performance, compliant, and employee-centric work environment for the unit. The role drives key people initiatives across talent acquisition, employee relations, learning and development, performance management, engagement, compliance, and HR administration. Working closely with business leaders and employees, the incumbent ensures effective people practices, operational excellence, workforce capability building, and alignment of HR strategies with organizational objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**HR Operations & Administration**

* Oversee end-to-end HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, HRIS administration, attendance management, employee documentation, policy implementation, and separation processes.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of employee records, payroll inputs, HR data, and statutory documentation.
* Manage employee welfare initiatives and workplace administration facilities, including employee services, amenities, identification management, and grievance handling.
* Continuously improve HR processes, systems, and service delivery standards.

**Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning**

* Manage recruitment activities to ensure timely fulfillment of manpower requirements.
* Partner with business leaders to understand workforce needs and develop manpower plans aligned with business objectives.
* Build and maintain relationships with recruitment partners and external talent sources.
* Monitor recruitment metrics and enhance hiring effectiveness and candidate experience.

**Learning & Development**

* Identify learning needs and support capability-building initiatives across the organization.
* Facilitate and coordinate employee training programs, inductions, compliance trainings, and development interventions.
* Monitor training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance outcomes.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning and professional development.

**Employee Relations & Engagement**

* Act as a trusted HR partner for employees and managers, addressing concerns with professionalism, empathy, and confidentiality.
* Handle employee relations matters, disciplinary processes, conflict resolution, and grievance management.
* Conduct exit interviews, analyze attrition trends, and recommend retention strategies.
* Drive employee engagement, recognition, wellness, inclusion, and communication initiatives to enhance the employee experience.

**Performance & Talent Management**

* Support the performance management cycle, including goal setting, reviews, calibration, and feedback processes.
* Facilitate talent reviews, succession planning, and employee development planning.
* Monitor workforce performance trends and recommend interventions to strengthen organizational effectiveness.

**HR Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare and present HR dashboards and reports covering headcount, attrition, recruitment, training, productivity, and other key people metrics.
* Leverage HR data and insights to support decision-making and improve organizational outcomes.
* Monitor HR budgets, workforce costs, and employee-related expenditures.

**Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, internal policies, and regulatory standards.
* Manage audits, inspections, background verification processes, and statutory documentation.
* Maintain confidentiality and security of employee information and records.
* Support the implementation and communication of HR policies and governance frameworks.

**Leadership & Business Partnership**

* Collaborate with functional leaders to align people strategies with business goals.
* Lead and implement HR projects, change management initiatives, and organizational development programs.
* Mentor and develop HR team members while fostering a collaborative and service-oriented culture.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across HR functions.

**Health, Safety & Wellbeing**

* Support implementation of workplace health, safety, and wellbeing initiatives.
* Coordinate safety awareness programs, emergency preparedness activities, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain records related to workplace incidents and support corrective and preventive actions.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of progressive HR experience, with strong exposure to HR operations, employee relations, talent management, and compliance preferably in wellness/hospitality

Digital HR Analyst
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time

41957
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Digital HR Analyst supports the design, configuration, testing, and optimization of HR technology systems whether through hands on implementation or strong business partnering with Technology resources. This role focuses on system functionality, access governance, elevated troubleshooting, and continuous enhancement.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone with strong hands-on HR technology experience, playing a larger role in system configuration of HR processes, can communicate strongly to ensure HR needs translate into sound system logic and influence design, enjoys working cross functionally and has strong project management skills.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
.
  
  
**Driving Technology Advancement**

* Appropriately solve HR problems with sustainable technical solutions in line with HR strategy, proactively managing impacts across systems, people and process.
* Configure and maintain HR systems according to requirements, updating settings, foundational data, workflows and security roles with precision.
* Serve as a key escalation point for complex system issues, partnering with IT and vendors to troubleshoot and resolve root causes.
* Own the full UAT lifecycle for their enhancements, including test script development, tester coordination, and validation that system updates support accurate and efficient business processes. Documents results, mitigates risks before deployment, identifies change impacts requiring communication or training, and surfaces process gaps to guide future enhancements.

**Access Management**

**User Enablement**

* Keep clear and consistent technical documentation, job aids and user guides updated, ensuring relevance and health of HR technology content.
* Contributing content to, and answering questions from, Digital Training initiatives to support HR staff in interacting with our technology.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* Provide expert input on system capabilities, constraints, and configuration options related to prioritized strategic initiatives.
* Facilitate working sessions to gather requirements, validate designs, and resolve issues where required.
* Represent HR in digital or process improvement initiatives as a subject matter contributor.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Strong understanding of HR processes (employee lifecycle, onboarding, timekeeping, talent management, performance, etc.)
* Proven ability to identify and manage change impacts of technology redesign.

* Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross functional teams.

* Enhancement coordination from facilitating requirement building for large process areas, design blueprinting, configuration, unit testing, user acceptance testing, change, deployment, operationalization.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in an agile manner, i.e. sprint-based execution.
* Experience using Agile tools to track work.

* System changes deployed smoothly with fewer defects and minimal post-release issues because validation is thorough and aligned with business processes.
* Recurring issues trend downward because root causes are being addressed.
* UAT cycles run efficiently, with clear scripts, coordinated testers, and well documented results. Defects are caught early, reducing rework and preventing production disruptions.
