* Responsible for optimizing deployment of BCG X resources to meet the needs of our business while ensuring each person receives opportunities supporting their Career Development objectives and long-term professional goals
* Maintain an acute awareness of the business environment and priorities; understand objectives of client/cases and openly communicate information relative to project opportunities with individuals while engaging with senior stakeholders and team leadership on staff portfolio
* Build strong relationships with BCG X talent to understand developmental needs and preferences for staffing; discuss upcoming projects; advise on staffing choices to achieve balance between business needs and personal preferences when possible; communicate staffing decisions and related rationale; set and enforce staffing policies and expectations
* Create visibility on current/planned resource allocation, considering diversity implications when staffing projects and teams holistically; ensuring fairness and equity with lens on people with different backgrounds and experiences
* Ensure relevant tools and trackers are maintained providing visibility of people commitments such project assignments, training and time off requests. Participate in the ongoing improvement of our staffing processes and systems
* Provide inputs into Career Development Committee (CDC) meetings and reinforce CD messages through staffing and development discussions to support individual development as required
* Provide input to BCG local HR and relevant stakeholders on employee matters when required
* Work with Regional People & Development stakeholders to provide career support and guidance around mobility programs including alignment with key stakeholders prior to approving mobility or other employee programs.
* Collaborate with Finance and ensure that financial approvals are considered and cooperate with finance in ensuring correct financial allocation of assigned resources
* Provide input to rest of staffing and HR team to maintain up to date accurate information on staff including project assignments, training, recruiting and time off

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Indicatively 2-4+ years’ experience in professional services and / or technology services environment, preferably in a staffing, workforce planning, people, or recruiting functions
* Bachelor's degree strongly preferred or equivalent years of relevant work experience
* Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work in BCG X Staffing Team and will collaborate with local BCG staffing and finance team to monitor billability, timesheet accuracy and work closely with the HR and Recruiting teams on talent strategies. You will build relationships and work effectively with members of billable and BST talent, Global X staffers, CDC, and the X Delivery leadership team.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
YOU’RE GOOD AT
  
  

* Performing successfully in a fast-paced, global, intellectually intense, service-oriented environment, keeping with BCG's values and culture
* Having excellent interpersonal skills, ability to communicate with all organizational levels inside and outside BCG through establishing positive and productive working relationships
* Having strong communication skills; able to communicate with confidence
* Being a proactive problem solver, ability to influence multiple stakeholders in a new point of view and be simultaneously flexible with adjusting own perspective considering new information or constraints
* Having high integrity, tact, a positive attitude, and an ability to maintain absolute confidentiality
* Being comfortable resolving conflict, delivering difficult messages and addressing all people related issues; excellent judgment and knows when to escalate
* Being an active team player, autonomous, able to manage ambiguity and self-motivated

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Head of HR Operations - International Recruitment & Deployment
description:
Job Opening: Head of Operations – International Recruitment & Deployment

Location: Delhi NCR

Experience: 8-12 years in overseas recruitment/deployment operations

Reports to: Managing Director

Compensation: ₹15–20 LPA fixed + variable up to ₹3 LPA

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

About Antal:

Antal International, East Patel Nagar Delhi, is a leading recruitment consultancy having expertise in connecting top talent across IT, Manufacturing and FMCG industries with leading organizations.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

About the role:

Turn every confirmed employer requirement into workers who arrive on time, fully documented, fully compliant and well supported – through a team and process that work without the founder in the loop.

Where it sits: the Business Head brings employer requirements; the Head – Candidate Acquisition builds the worker pool; the Head of Operations converts both into deployed, settled workers. Sourcing candidates is not this role's primary job, but it sets the quality bar for every candidate handed over.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Delivery planning - Turn each confirmed employer order into a plan – numbers, timelines, documents, owners. Flag feasibility risks before work begins.

• Final eligibility & deployment-readiness check - Verify that candidates handed over by Candidate Acquisition meet employer, documentation and deployment requirements before the employer interview. Schedule employer interviews; keep selected / rejected / waitlisted records.

• Documentation & compliance check - Own the document-control system: every file checked before submission. Ensure operational adherence to applicable MEA / eMigrate, recruiting-agent and destination-country requirements, in coordination with authorised legal / immigration professionals wherever required, and to VGIL's ethical recruitment policy – contract terms explained to the worker, transparent payments with receipts, truthful embassy preparation.

• Visa & work permits - Coordinate visa and work-permit steps with the embassy / visa centre in New Delhi and with authorised legal / immigration professionals and representatives abroad; track every application to closure.

• Pre-departure & deployment - Orientation on job, wages, hours, accommodation and rights; tickets; airport readiness; track each worker until handover to the employer.

• Post-arrival support & troubleshooting - Single escalation point for workers and employers after arrival. Coordinate and track residence-permit filings with the overseas partner, and resolve issues such as accommodation, wage or contract mismatches, health issues, disputes and early-exit risks. Resolve or escalate within agreed timelines; log every case.

• Team management, reviews & team building - Hire, train and lead the operations team. Set clear individual ownership and targets; run daily stand-ups, weekly reviews and monthly performance reviews. Build a second line so operations never depend on one person.

• Systems, SOPs & reporting - One master tracker / CRM for every live case; SOPs, checklists, turnaround-time standards and an escalation matrix for each stage; weekly operations dashboard to the MD.

• Partners & vendors - Manage medical centres, travel agents, document vendors and overseas representatives on quality, cost and speed.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

IDEAL CANDIDATE

Must have

• 8+ years in overseas recruitment / deployment operations, including 3+ years leading an operations team.

• Personally run the full cycle – screening, employer interviews, documentation, medicals, visa / work-permit coordination, travel, deployment and post-arrival issues – for bulk blue-collar or semi-skilled requirements (50–300+ workers).

• Working knowledge of Indian emigration rules (MEA / eMigrate, recruiting-agent obligations) and of European work-permit processes.

• Has hired, trained and reviewed a team, and can show trackers or SOPs they built.

• High integrity on worker welfare and compliance. Strong Hindi and English; Punjabi is an advantage.

Good to have

• Greece or other European deployment experience; agriculture, food-processing, construction or hospitality workforces.

• Has built an operations function in a growing, founder-led firm; strong Excel / CRM discipline.

Not a fit: Domestic-only recruiters, HR generalists, IT / white-collar recruiters, visa counsellors without bulk deployment experience, people who have only sourced candidates, operations managers from unrelated industries, or anyone who cannot walk us through an end-to-end deployment they personally managed.

EDUCATION

• Bachelor's degree preferred (B.Com / BBA / BA / HR / Operations or equivalent).

• MBA / PGDM in Operations or HR is an advantage, not a requirement.

• Actual overseas recruitment and deployment experience matters far more than academic qualification

title: HR System Specialist
description:
NWI Precision specializes in high-precision machining of helicopter masts, turbine shafts, engine thrust links, and nuclear pressure vessel components for the aerospace and nuclear industries worldwide. Operating from a 120,000 sq. ft. facility at 9 Fenmar Drive in Toronto, our dedicated team is committed to delivering the highest quality products to specifications and on time.
  
  
POSITION DESCRIPTION: The HR Systems Specialist reports directly into the Director, Human Resources. This role is pivotal in supporting the foundational pillars of HR operations, with a specialized focus on compliance, audit readiness, HR systems management and process coordination. The incumbent will ensure that all HR practices records and systems adhere to provincial/federal laws and stringent industry-specific regulators (CGP, ITAR) while providing essential support across recruitment, onboarding, employee relations and HR projects. TECHNICAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Compliance & Audit Management:
  
  

* Serve as the primary coordinator for all HR-related audits (internal, external, regulatory, and client driven). Prepare audit materials, manage responses and track findings to closure.
* Develop, maintain, and audit centralized systems for critical employee records to ensure ongoing compliance, with primary emphasis on training/certification records, mandatory policy acknowledgements and security clearances (CGP, ITAR).
* Proactively monitor regulatory changes and update HR checklists, procedures, and documentation to ensure continuous compliance with employment standards, human rights, privacy and industry regulations.
* Conduct regular audits of HR files, both digital and physical to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance with retention policies. HR Systems & Process Coordination:
* Act as a key liaison and super-user for HRIS. Assist in implementing, configuring and optimizing HR systems to ensure they are built and utilized to support compliance requirements (e.g. automated renewal notifications, report generation for audits).
* Coordinate and track the completion of mandatory employee training programs, running regular reports and partnering with managers to ensure 100% compliance.
* Assist with managing and administer all leave of absence cases (medical, WSIB, etc..) ensuring accurate documentation and system tracking.
* Assist the Director of HR with performance review and merit cycle processes, ensuring system readiness and timeline adherence, following up with leadership when needed to meet deadlines.
* Focuses on the technology and data within Human Resources, managing HR software, analyzing workforce data, and streamlining HR processes through digital tools for recruitment, payroll, benefits, and performance, essentially bridging HR expertise with IT solutions to boost efficiency and strategic decision-making.
* Ensure HR systems work, help with data integrity, and use analytics to support business goals.
* Identifying ways to automate and streamline HR tasks using technology. HR Generalist Support:
* Act as a point of contact for routine employee inquiries, guiding them to appropriate resources and escalating complex employee relations matters as needed.
* Assist with full-cycle recruitment, onboarding, and offboarding processes, ensuring each step is documented and compliant.
* Assist with updating HR policies and procedures, focusing on clarity, accessibility and compliance alignment.
* Coordinate employee events and training sessions in collaboration with other departments.
* Assist with investigations and conflict resolution by ensuring proper documentation and process adherence. Reporting & Analysis:
* Prepare and analyze key HR metrics related to compliance (e.g. training completion rates, audit outcomes), headcount and turnover.
* Generate regular and ad-hoc reports from HR systems to support audit requests, management reviews and strategic decision-making.
* Complete additional projects and responsibilities as required. KEY PERFORMANCE DELIVERABLES:
* Achieve 100% readiness for announced and unannounced HR compliance audits.
* Maintain accuracy and timeliness for mandatory training and certification records.
* Ensure HRIS and other systems are effectively configured to support and prove compliance.
* Ensure 100% compliance with Controlled Goods (CGP) and ITAR personnel requirements.
* Reduction in compliance-related findings through proactive process improvements.
* Positive feedback from auditors and management on the organization and accessibility of HR records.
* Lead to 100% automated processes in HR related function minimizing data entry and paper retrieval records QUALIFICATIONS: EDUCATION:
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field
* HR certification (e.g. CHRP) or progress towards certification is a strong asset. EXPERIENCE/KNOWLEDGE:
* 3+ years of experience in an HR Information technology System, specialist role, with a demonstrated focus on automation, compliance, records management or audit preparation
* Expert in Business Analytics
* Proven experience on implementation of HR Systems in small medium size company
* Experience in a manufacturing. Defense or other highly regulated environment is highly preferred.
* Knowledge of Canadian employment legislation (federal and provincial).
* Practical experience with HRIS implementation, administration and reporting.
* Familiarity with CGP and ITAR compliance is an asset.
* Strong communication skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. SKILLS & ABILITIES:
* Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
* High degree of proficiency with HRIS, MS Office (especially Excel), and document management systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a process-improvement mindset.
* Ability to handle confidential information with utmost discretion and integrity.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain compliance requirements clearly.
* Proactive, self-directed and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative, solution-oriented approach.
* Confidentiality and objectivity, with a positive ‘can-do’ attitude.
* Focused on a positive employee experience with finding solutions. HEALTH AND SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES: Support operational managers in maintaining compliance with the provisions of the Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA), regulations, and internal health and safety policies and procedures. Help create a healthy work environment by bringing the parties together and facilitating meaningful dialogue, acting as a mediator between management and workers where necessary, communicating to employees the organization’s commitment to occupational health and safety, and training managers and employees on safe work practices.
* Work in compliance with the provisions of the Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA), regulations, and internal health and safety policies and procedures
* Help create a healthy work environment by not condoning, participating in or reporting, as you become aware, any harassment, discrimination, gossiping or unfair treatment of anyone

* Report any contravention of the OHSA regulations, or NWI safety policies and procedures by another employee

* DO NOT engage in any prank, contest, feat of strength, unnecessary running or rough and boisterous conduct

title: Manager – HR Operations
description:
**Job Title / Designation:**
Manager – HR Operations (AI Team)

**Qualification:**
Bachelor’s degree

**Reporting To:**
Programme Director, AI Team, NeGD, working in close coordination with the HR Division, NeGD

**Nature of Role:**
Individual contributor

**Overview**

* The Manager (HR Operations) will manage HR operations for NeGD’s AI team covering the full employee lifecycle for directly engaged staff and for specialist manpower deployed through empanelled agencies. This role will work in close coordination with NeGD’s HR Division.
* The AI team is being built rapidly and competes for scarce technical talent. The position requires a hands-on, process-oriented HR professional who can run high-volume technical recruitment with speed and rigour, maintain accurate records, and ensure that every HR action complies with NeGD policies and government procedures.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

Recruitment and Selection

* Manage end-to-end recruitment coordination for AI team roles across all channels, including direct advertisement, job portals, and empanelled agencies, with consolidation, de-duplication and tracking of applications
* Coordinate screening, technical assessments and interview panels, schedule interviews, and prepare selection documentation and panel records
* Conduct background, reference and credential verification, covering identity, qualifications, employment history, and flag discrepancies for review
* Handle candidate data in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023

Agency Manpower

* Coordinate with empanelled agencies on nomination of candidates against approved role requirements and rate cards, and on deployment, replacement and exit of resources
* Verify monthly attendance and deployment records of agency resources, and provide inputs to the Procurement & Finance Manager for verification of agency invoices against agreed rate cards

Onboarding, Employee Lifecycle and Exits

* Manage joining formalities, induction and onboarding, including coordination with IT and Administration for system access, devices, accounts and workspace
* Maintain contract, probation and renewal trackers, and initiate extensions, renewals and performance reviews in time
* Manage exit formalities, including revocation of access and handover of work
* Administer attendance and leave for the team, and provide timely payroll inputs to NeGD HR

Coordination with NeGD HR

* Prepare HR notes, approval drafts, office orders, offer and engagement letters, and extension and relieving letters for processing through NeGD HR
* Ensure all HR actions follow NeGD HR policies, the delegation of powers and government procedures, and keep NeGD HR records and HRMIS up to date for the AI team

Records, MIS and Compliance

* Maintain employee master data, manpower and vacancy trackers, and recruitment pipeline dashboards for the AI team
* Prepare periodic MIS reports on hiring status, time to hire, attrition, contract expiries and agency deployment for the Programme Director
* Maintain HR records for audit, RTI, parliamentary questions and internal review
* Handle employee queries and grievances promptly and with discretion

Experience Criteria

* Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in HR operations, recruitment coordination, employee lifecycle management, HR documentation or payroll coordination, including at least 3 years supporting recruitment for technology, product or engineering roles

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of end-to-end recruitment and employee lifecycle processes
* Experience running high-volume recruitment pipelines across multiple sourcing channels, with accurate tracking and reporting
* Experience in background, reference and credential verification
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel (including pivot tables and lookups), Word, PowerPoint, applicant tracking systems and digital HR tools
* Strong drafting skills for official correspondence, HR notes and letters
* Ability to work independently as an individual contributor and to coordinate with multiple stakeholders against tight timelines
* High attention to detail, integrity, confidentiality and service orientation

**Desirable Requirements**

* MBA / PGDM / Master’s degree in HR, Personnel Management, Public Administration or a related discipline
* Familiarity with technical hiring in AI/ML, data and software engineering, including common role titles, skills and assessment methods
* Experience with applicant tracking systems, HRMIS, HR analytics or automation of HR workflows
* Experience in government organisations, autonomous bodies, PSUs or large technology programmes
* Familiarity with contractual staffing, manpower agency coordination, rate-card-based engagements, government procedures and audit requirements
* Working knowledge of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 as it applies to candidate and employee data

* Drive change management and organizational effectiveness programs.

title: Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Founder's Office)
description:
**Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Founder's Office)**

**The Short version**

**Who we're looking for:**
A sharp, high-intensity problem solver with 3 to 6 years of experience, who cares deeply about education and is happiest when handed a messy problem with no playbook.

**What the role is about:**
You'll work directly with our CEO on the strategic priorities that will shape Kraftshala's next phase of growth, across admissions, training, placements, tech, partnerships, and scale, and you'll own each one from start to finish.

**Why you should apply:**
You'll work on some of the hardest and most critical problems in the company, alongside people with extraordinary expertise in skilling and training. There's a lot to learn here, and plenty of room to grow.

**About Us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The Detailed Version**

Our goal is simple: drive placements. That takes stellar admissions, training and placement processes, strong technology and deep partnerships across the ecosystem, and keeping all of it stellar as our programs grow. This role exists to solve the cross-functional problems that get in the way of that, working alongside the founder as priorities shift.

**Responsibilities & Metrics to Measure:**

* Take ambiguous, high-priority problems from the founder, break them down, find root causes using data, and turn them into a clear plan with owners and timelines.
* Spot where our programs risk slipping into mediocrity as they scale, across learner outcomes, placement quality and delivery standards, and fix the gaps at a system level.
* Run small, quick experiments on problem areas as they come up, share what worked and what didn't, and change course when the data or priorities shift.
* Act as the founder's thinking partner through sharp analyses, decision memos and reviews, and turn solved problems into repeatable processes that teams can run on their own.

**Top Grading**

* **Proactiveness:**
  An A-Player spots the next problem before being told and moves on it, whereas a B-Player waits for direction and does well only once the task is clearly defined.
* **Intensity & Focus:**
  An A-Player attacks the most important problem with urgency until it's solved, whereas a B-Player spreads effort thin and lets momentum fade after the first push.
* **Structuring Ambiguity:**
  An A-Player turns a vague, messy problem into a clear problem statement, hypothesis and plan, whereas a B-Player either waits for clarity or jumps into action without a frame.
* **Iterative Learning:**
  An A-Player tests fast, learns from what didn't work and changes course without ego, whereas a B-Player sticks to the original plan even when the data says otherwise.
* **Cross-functional Influence:**
  An A-Player gets teams they don't manage to move by building trust and making a clear case, whereas a B-Player leans on the founder's name to get things done.
* **Adaptability:**
  An A-Player shifts gears calmly when priorities change and carries the learnings forward, whereas a B-Player treats every change as a disruption and loses pace.
* **Passion for Education:**
  An A-Player believes in the cause of education and finds ways to drive change, whether through learner outcomes, access to opportunity, better systems or shifting mindsets, whereas a B-Player sees education as just another sector to work in.

**Ideal Candidate**

You have 3 to 6 years of experience solving real problems end-to-end. You might come from consulting, strategy, a founder's office or business operations, or from any role where you've had to work through varied, unstructured problems with no fixed playbook.

* A clear, genuine interest in education is a must. Prior exposure to the sector, whether through edtech, skilling or teaching, is a strong plus.
* You've taken an ambiguous problem, given it structure, and delivered a measurable result, ideally while working across teams you didn't directly manage.
* You're looking to build deep context and grow with us over the long term, not a short stint.

**Location**

Delhi / Gurugram

Know more about Kraftshala's philosophy, culture and investors here.

title: Global Leave & Absence Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1800+ experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team:**
You will be part of Ramboll's Global HR Operations team, which provides HR operations services to various countries across Ramboll using global HR applications (e.g., Workday).
  
  
As the
**Global Leave & Absence Specialist**
, you will be the specialist resource for leave and absence management within Global HR Operations. You will own the accuracy, consistency, and continuous improvement of leave and absence processes across the countries serviced, acting as the point of expertise for complex cases, process design, and Workday absence configuration — while also contributing to wider HR Operations service delivery linked to the employee lifecycle.
  
  
**Main Role Responsibilities**

* Leave & Absence Process Expertise: Act as the subject matter expert for leave and absence processes globally — including maternity/parental leave, sick leave, statutory and company-specific leave types, disability/medical leave, and other absence categories across multiple countries.
* Complex Case Resolution: Own and resolve complex or non-standard leave cases (e.g., extended medical leave, intermittent leave, leave-pay interactions, return-to-work scenarios), acting as the escalation point for the wider HR Operations team.
* Process Design & Standardization: Design, document, and continuously improve global leave and absence processes, identifying opportunities for standardization and automation across countries.
* Workday Absence Configuration: Partner with the HRIS/Workday team on absence plan configuration, testing, and troubleshooting; identify and raise system gaps or defects affecting leave processing, and support enhancement projects.
* Statutory & Policy Currency: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of statutory leave entitlements and regulatory changes across countries serviced, and translate these into updated processes, guides, and system configurations.
* Payroll Interface: Ensure leave data flows accurately into payroll, working closely with Global Payroll and in-country teams to coordinate statutory pay, unpaid-leave deductions, and return-to-work pay changes; validate absence data ahead of payroll cut-off dates and investigate and resolve leave-related payroll discrepancies.
* General HR Operations & Workday Support: Provide broader HR Operations process and Workday system support (service requests, data updates, change requests) as part of the team's day-to-day delivery.
* Query & Ticket Resolution: Handle and resolve leave and absence-related tickets and queries from employees, managers, and in-country HR teams, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs and turnaround times.
* Documentation & Training: Own the creation and maintenance of leave and absence SOPs, quick guides, step-by-step guides, and training materials for the wider HR Operations team to reference.
* Knowledge Sharing & Coaching: Act as the go-to resource for leave and absence questions across the HR Operations team, coaching colleagues on process nuances and edge cases.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Participate in weekly/monthly update calls with countries and the Global HR Operations team, representing leave and absence topics and providing status updates on ongoing initiatives.
* Benefits Coordination: Liaise with global and local benefits teams, insurers, and providers to ensure correct handling of benefits (e.g., income protection, disability, statutory entitlements) during leave, and keep employees informed of the benefit implications of their leave.
* Global Policy & Data Compliance: Support the harmonization of global and local leave and absence policies with People Advisory, legal, and payroll teams, and ensure all leave-related activities comply with data privacy and confidentiality requirements (including GDPR and local equivalents); support internal and external audits as needed.
* Vendor & Provider Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for external vendors involved in leave administration, including payroll providers, benefit providers, insurers, and occupational health providers, coordinating on claims, certificates, and return-to-work arrangements.
* Reporting & Analytics: Prepare regular and ad hoc reporting on leave trends, absence utilization, and payroll-impacting leave; analyze the data to flag risks and provide insights that support workforce planning, policy review, and wellbeing initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* HR Operations experience gained in an international, multi-cultural organization.
* 5-7+ years of experience in Global HR Operations, with demonstrated depth in leave and absence management across multiple countries.
* Hands-on experience administering and/or configuring leave/absence processes in an HRIS tool (Workday strongly preferred; PeopleSoft, Oracle, SAP, or similar also considered).
* Working knowledge of how statutory leave entitlements and practices vary across jurisdictions; exposure to multiple countries/regions preferred.
* Service-minded, with a strong understanding of good customer service in a shared-services/global environment.
* Experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.
* Systematic and structured working style with strong attention to detail, given the compliance sensitivity of leave data.
* Strong self-starter, comfortable operating as an individual contributor and subject matter resource without formal line management responsibility.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills; fluent in English, both verbal and written.
* Innovative and problem-solving approach, particularly for ambiguous or non-standard cases.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency.
* Preferred Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Law, or a related field; a professional HR, payroll, or benefits certification is an advantage.
* Regional Breadth: Experience supporting countries across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific is highly advantageous.

**Personal Qualities**

* Strong communicator, open, transparent, and takes initiative.
* Excellent interpersonal and active listening skills.
* Strong critical thinking, able to balance case-level detail with the bigger picture.
* Sound judgement and decision-making; takes ownership and accountability for the accuracy and compliance of leave and absence outcomes.
* Well-structured, organized way of working.

description:
Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998. Tower has built its business on a high-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities.
  
  
Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.
  
  
Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.
  
  
At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best
  
  
At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.
  
  
**Responsibilities :**
The HR Intern will work closely with the Recruitment and HRBP team, supporting end-to-end recruitment activities, interview coordination, and other HR initiatives.
  
  

* Supporting recruitment activities, including scheduling interviews, coordinating feedback, and assisting with documentation.
* Managing candidate communication and interview coordination to ensure a timely, seamless, and positive candidate experience .
* Supporting campus recruitment initiatives, including university coordination, application management, assessments, interview scheduling, and offer processes.
* Maintaining accurate and up-to-date candidate information in Greenhouse and other internal trackers.

**Qualifications :**

* Holding a Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Human Resources.
* Demonstrating strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Showing enthusiasm for interacting with candidates and stakeholders.
* Maintaining strong attention to detail and taking a proactive approach to work.
* Managing multiple tasks, priorities, and timelines in a fast-paced environment.
* Building a career in Recruitment/Talent Acquisition/Human Resources, with prior internship or project experience being an advantage.

**Benefits:**
Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.
  
  
At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* Generous paid time off policies
* Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
* Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
* In-office wellness experiences.
* Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
* Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
* Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
* Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.
  
  
Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Energeia is an Industrial Energy Savings Company. We find energy waste in factories and commercial buildings, fix it, and get paid from the savings we verify. Since 2018 we have completed 1,200+ site appraisals and 250+ energy audits, and saved customers ₹256 Crore in energy costs. We are a BEE-accredited ESCO with offices in 5 cities and technology partnerships with ABB, L&T and GFS Corp (USA).

In August 2026 we launched August Energeia with Singapore-based August Energy: a $100M platform that finances, installs and operates energy infrastructure for Indian industry, so customers pay from savings instead of upfront capex. Energeia brings the audits, engineering, sales and the IoT and AI platform behind every project.

**WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW**

We are scaling from 54 people toward 75 over the next 12 months without losing the culture that got us here. You will design how.

Payroll and compliance have to stay flawless. The next phase also needs auditors and engineers hired faster than the market, a performance system people trust, and retention we measure instead of guess. This role reports to the CEO, with a clear path to Head of People.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

• Hiring: end-to-end recruitment across 5 cities, from trainees to senior leaders, through Naukri, LinkedIn, agencies and referrals

• Structured hiring: scorecards for every role, and coaching hiring managers to use them

• Onboarding: joining, induction and 30/60/90 plans for every new hire

• Payroll and HR operations: monthly payroll, attendance and leave reconciliation in Zoho People, and every employee letter from offer to relieving

• Statutory compliance: PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH, Shops and Establishments and annual labour-law returns in every state we operate in

• Performance: goal setting, probation reviews and the annual review cycle with calibration

• Employee relations: a logged grievance mechanism, fair and confidential investigations, and exits through full-and-final

• Engagement and retention: eNPS, surveys, town halls and recognition; analyse attrition and act on it

• Company offsites: plan and run offsites end to end, from agenda and venue to logistics and budget

• HR systems and MIS: monthly headcount, attrition and hiring dashboards; handbook, policies and SOPs; AI tools to automate the routine

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

• 30 days: fully onboarded on our systems: Zoho People, payroll, statutory filings and POSH

• 90 days: hiring and recruitment plan aligned with the CEO and function heads

• 6 months: 10 roles hired, written goals for every employee, zero payroll errors

• 12 months: ~20 roles closed with median time-to-hire under 45 days and 90-day retention of 85%+; review cycle completed with calibrated ratings; 100% statutory compliance; eNPS baseline set and improving

**WHAT YOU BRING**

• 6 to 10 years in HR, including 3+ as the senior HR person in a growing company of roughly 50 to 500 people

• End-to-end recruitment at volume, including technical or field roles, with time-to-hire and quality numbers you can quote

• Hands-on payroll ownership on an HRMS, ideally Zoho People

• Working knowledge of Indian labour law and multi-state statutory compliance, including POSH

• Has designed or run a performance review cycle end to end

• Can build a headcount and attrition report from raw data in Excel or Google Sheets

• Sound judgement and discretion on grievances, exits and pay

**STRONG PLUS**

• MBA or PGDM in HR, or a master's in HR or Industrial Relations

• Hiring engineers, auditors or site teams in manufacturing, EPC, energy or industrial services

• Startup or scale-up experience

• POSH Internal Committee experience

• Zoho One, and daily use of AI tools (Claude or similar)

**HOW WE WORK**

• Trust: radical openness and transparency in everything we do

• Growth mindset: experiment, fail forward, invest in your own learning

• Ownership: results-driven people who solve more than their own problems

• Community: collaborative, inclusive teams that enjoy working together

• Fairness and decency: do what is right, not what is easier

• Resilience: welcome the challenges that push us, and come back stronger

**WHAT WE OFFER**

• Competitive compensation based on experience

• A direct line to the CEO and a defined path to Head of People

• A people function in its biggest growth phase, yours to build

• Exposure to global partners: ABB, GFS Corp and August Energy

**THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF**

• You want to set strategy and hand payroll to a team. For the first year, you are the team.

• You need a finished HR playbook. Much of ours is still being written, and you will write it.

• You wait for problems to reach you. Grievances, attrition and compliance deadlines need someone who goes looking.

Energeia is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skill and ownership, and welcome applicants of every background.

title: Human Resources Director
description:
**DIRECTOR – HUMAN RESOURCES**

**Location:**
Delhi/NCR

**Our Client:**
A 150-room Five Star Deluxe Hotel, affiliated with a leading brand

**About the Role**

The Director – Human Resources will be responsible for
**leading the hotel's Human Resources function, ensuring effective people management practices, employee engagement, and organizational development.**
The role will focus on attracting, developing, and retaining talent, maintaining harmonious employee relations, and fostering a positive work culture aligned with the hotel's business objectives and service standards.

The incumbent will partner with the General Manager and departmental heads to drive HR strategy, optimize manpower resources, ensure statutory compliance, and build a high-performance team committed to delivering exceptional guest satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement the hotel's HR policies, systems, and procedures in alignment with organizational objectives and brand standards.
* Lead
  **manpower planning, recruitment, and selection**
  to ensure timely availability of competent personnel across all departments.
* Oversee the complete
  **employee lifecycle**
  , including onboarding, induction, performance management, career development, and separation.
* Establish and maintain effective
  **performance appraisal systems**
  , linking individual performance with departmental and organizational goals.
* Develop initiatives to enhance
  **employee engagement,**
  motivation, retention, and overall workplace satisfaction.
* Partner with the General Manager and departmental heads to assess manpower requirements, organizational structures, and workforce productivity.
* Prepare and monitor the annual HR budget, manpower costs, payroll, employee benefits, and other personnel-related expenses.
* Ensure
  **compliance**
  with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, hotel policies, and established HR procedures.
* Manage
  **employee relation**
  s, grievance redressal, disciplinary matters, and workplace issues, ensuring fairness and consistency in implementation.
* Design and implement
  **training and development initiatives**
  in coordination with departmental heads to strengthen employee capabilities and service delivery.
* Identify high-potential employees and develop succession planning and career progression initiatives for key positions.
* Monitor employee turnover, absenteeism, recruitment effectiveness, training outcomes, and other HR performance indicators; recommend corrective measures as required.
* Ensure effective implementation of employee welfare initiatives, recognition programmes, and internal communication practices.
* Foster a collaborative work environment and promote the hotel's service culture, values, and standards across all departments.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR documentation, management reports, and personnel information with appropriate confidentiality.
* Coordinate with department heads to address operational HR requirements and ensure smooth day-to-day functioning of the hotel.
* Conduct periodic HR reviews and audits to evaluate the effectiveness of HR processes and recommend improvements.
* Lead, coach, and develop the HR team, ensuring professional standards and effective delivery of HR services.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* **Approximately 15 years of relevant HR experience in the Hospitality Industry, with demonstrated experience in a senior HR leadership role with 5 star Deluxe Hotels.**
* Proven track record in
  **managing the complete HR function within a five-star, upscale hotel**
  or a comparable service-oriented organization.
* Strong knowledge of HR policies, manpower planning, recruitment, employee engagement, performance management, and learning and development.
* Sound understanding of applicable labour laws, statutory compliance, employee relations, and disciplinary procedures.
* Demonstrated ability to manage HR budgets, payroll costs, workforce productivity, and manpower optimization.
* Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, and people-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with the General Manager, departmental heads, and cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to interpret HR data and translate insights into actionable plans.
* Proven ability to motivate teams, manage workplace challenges, and build a positive and performance-driven work culture.
* High standards of integrity, discretion, confidentiality, and professional conduct.
* Proficiency in MS Office and familiarity with HRMS and other relevant HR technologies.

title: Team Leader-Human Resources

title: Senior HRBP, Delhi NCR
description:
**Description**
The individual will implement HR plans and solutions in order to achieve strategic business initiatives and deliver results. The candidate will possess the ability to complete high volumes of tasks with minimal guidance or supervision and deadline sensitivity. As such, the candidate must be skilled at anticipating problems, creating contingency plans, managing multiple priorities, problem solving and organizing logistics. Key to the position is the ability to keep the team organized, prioritized and on time while also serving as a "go to" for all areas and departments which dovetail with HR. This candidate will help foster a cooperative and communicative atmosphere.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Examine situations thoroughly, check for and mitigate personal biases, and make high-judgment decisions that align with the intent of policies and minimize risk. Ensure fair and consistent application of all company policies and compliance with laws and regulations. Take partners or escalate when next steps are unclear.
  
  
Prioritize the employee experience and following up on matters that are critical to protecting it, such as safety, pay and scheduling. Propose solutions and take partners to resolve issues quickly. Ensure that next steps are consistently communicated to employees.
  
  
Participate in talent development and talent management processes with business leadership. Respectfully challenge talent outcomes and ensure business leaders are trained to conduct effective career growth and performance management discussions. Provide feedback and coach leaders to successfully manage complex employee issues while meeting organizational goals.
  
  
Use data and metrics to identify trends, anticipate business needs, and implement action plans focused on employee experience and organizational health.
  
  
Set culture and talent goals with business leaders. Review culture and talent management data regularly, create action plans to address opportunities and routinely assess their effectiveness. Champion change focused on creating and fostering a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  

* Responsible for onboarding and partnering with the recruitment team in hiring associates based on business forecasts.
* Partner with business leaders and other support functions to maintain a highly motivated and engaged workforce
* Implement new policies, procedures and programs in support of Business
* Be the first point of contact for all employee grievances and partner with the HR Business Partner in conducting necessary investigations.
* Provide MIS support for Attrition analysis, includes- analyzing Exit interview , observe trends and highlight important aspects, prepare and publish dashboards
* Drive engagement initiatives like – New hire Buddy/ mentoring program, Voice of Employee, Round tables and Brown Bag session and R&Rs
* Partner with HRBPs to drive Career pathing sessions/ initiatives
* Support the L&D team in conducting training needs assessment for employees across levels
* Responsible in conducting regular vendor audits to ensure labor compliance.
* Responsible for statutory compliance

A day in the life
  
  
A typical day in this role involves providing strategic and tactical leadership direction, executing on people initiatives, providing internal customer support, advising and coaching employees and leaders through development and performance matters, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. This role operates with autonomy and requires discretion and a hands-on approach to monitor the "pulse" of the employees to ensure a high level of engagement. The Sr. HRBP routinely partners with leaders at multiple levels of the organization to develop forward-looking strategies and goals focused on the employee experience and operational objectives. Implement employee surveys and questionnaires; help HRBP’s in analysis and action planning based on survey results.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of human resources leadership experience
* Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting hourly employee client groups (warehouse/distribution, manufacturing, or call center environments)

* Train end users and create collateral to target audiences

* 5-7 years of experience in Workday system management, People technology, or related Program Management role.

* Demonstrated ability to own and deliver cross-functional projects from start to finish, influencing peers and stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.

* Experience acting as an autonomous owner of project deliverables and mentoring junior team members.

* Deep functional expertise in Workday Core HCM is required. Hands-on experience with Business Process (BP) configuration, advanced reporting, and EIBs is essential.

* Proven ability to translate business needs into functional requirements and system specifications.

* Experience acting as a functional system owner, responsible for governance, roadmap development, and solution design, not just operational support.

* Proven experience in a global systems role, with direct responsibility for supporting stakeholders in North America / U.S. time zones.

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted and influential voice in planning discussions.

* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

title: Human Resources Lead
description:
**Are you an HR professional who wants to do more than paperwork? Ready to build a culture, not just manage one?**

At
**Sheows**
, we believe a company is only as strong as its people. We are looking for a sharp, driven and people-first
**HR Lead**
to own our HR function and play a key role in our next phase of growth.

📌 Job Snapshot

📍
**Location:**
Gurgaon

💼
**Experience:**
4 to 7 years in HR

💰
**Salary:**
₹60,000 – ₹70,000 per month

🕒
**Job Type:**
Full-time, Work from Office

👤
**Reports To:**
CEO

⏳
**Joining:**
Immediate

🎯 About the Role

This is a leadership position, not a support role. As HR Lead, you will be the face of HR at Sheows, working directly with the leadership team to attract the right talent, keep them engaged and build systems that scale with the business.

🛠️ Key Responsibilities

**Talent Acquisition**

* Own the complete hiring cycle: manpower planning, JD creation, sourcing, screening, interviews, offer negotiation and closure
* Build a strong talent pipeline through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and campus channels
* Reduce time-to-hire while maintaining quality of hire

**Onboarding & Induction**

* Run a smooth onboarding process, from documentation to day-one experience
* Conduct induction programs so new joiners settle in faster

**Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Plan engagement activities, recognition programs and team-building initiatives
* Collect regular feedback and act on it to improve retention

**Performance Management**

* Design and run KRA/KPI-based performance review cycles
* Support managers with appraisals, feedback and development plans

**HR Operations**

* Manage attendance, leave, payroll inputs and employee records
* Maintain HR MIS, dashboards and monthly reports

**Statutory Compliance & Legal**

* Ensure timely registration, filing and compliance under:
* **EPF**
  (Employees’ Provident Fund): monthly ECR filing and contributions
* **ESIC**
  (Employees’ State Insurance): registration, contributions and returns
* **Payment of Gratuity Act**
* **Minimum Wages Act**
  and applicable state wage regulations
* **Shops & Establishment Act**
  (registration, renewals, leave and working-hours norms)
* **Professional Tax**
  and
  **TDS on salary**
  (coordinating with the finance/accounts team)
* **Maternity Benefit Act**
  and other applicable labour laws
* **POSH Act**
  : constitution and functioning of the Internal Committee (IC), annual reports and awareness sessions
* Maintain statutory registers, records and documentation, and stay audit-ready at all times
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors and government authorities during inspections and audits
* Keep track of changes in labour codes and update company policies accordingly

**Policy & Employee Relations**

* Create, update and implement HR policies, SOPs, appointment letters and employee handbook
* Handle grievances and disciplinary matters fairly and confidentially
* Manage exit formalities, including exit interviews, notice period, and full & final settlement

**Strategic Partnership**

* Advise leadership on organization structure, compensation and workforce planning
* Strengthen Sheows’ employer brand on LinkedIn and other platforms

✅ What We’re Looking For

**Must have**

* Bachelor’s degree in any stream; MBA / PGDM in HR preferred
* 4 to 7 years of hands-on HR experience, with at least 1 to 2 years in a lead role
* Strong command over end-to-end recruitment and HR operations
* **Solid working knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance (EPF, ESIC, Gratuity, Bonus, PT, POSH, Shops & Establishment Act)**
* **Hands-on experience in compliance filings, audits and handling inspections**
* Excellent communication, negotiation and people-management skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS tools and LinkedIn Recruiter
* Comfortable working from the office on a full-time basis

**Good to have**

* Experience in a startup or fast-growing company
* Exposure to payroll processing and HR analytics
* Knowledge of the new Labour Codes
* Experience in employer branding initiatives

🌟 You’ll Thrive Here If You

* Take ownership and don’t wait to be told what to do
* Are equally comfortable with people and data
* Are detail-oriented and never miss a compliance deadline
* Stay calm under pressure and handle sensitive situations with maturity
* Think like a business partner, not just an HR executive

🎁 Why Join Sheows?

✨
**Leadership role**
with real ownership and direct access to decision-makers

📈
**Growth-oriented environment**
where you shape the HR function

💰
**Competitive salary**
of ₹60,000 – ₹70,000 per month

🤝
**People-first culture**
that values respect, learning and accountability

🏢
**Collaborative office environment**
where you work closely with the team and leadership

🚀
**Exposure**
to every part of the business

📩 How to Apply

Apply directly through this post or send your updated CV to hrgurgaon@sheows.org with the subject line
**“HR Lead ”**
.

Publicis Sapient is looking for a Manager – People Shared Services to join our team of bright thinkers and doers. The role is designed to support the HR Shared Services team in India. It will primarily revolve around identifying, evaluating, developing and acting as SME on the people processes, labor compliances, performance management, employee life cycle (Onboarding, Learning Management, Global Background checks, Helpdesk etc.), and managing the day-to-day functioning of Shared Services ops team or project team. The role also entails a variety of projects and assignments like Process Redesign, Reporting & Dashboards, HR Account Management, using tools to improve efficiency and scalability of processes, working with several stakeholders to collect data points and analyzing the same to recommend improvement opportunities, creating process maps and documents as knowledge repository etc.
**Your Impact:**
**Team Leadership and Management**

* Works with senior leadership to ensure consistent people processes and practices across the company
* Manages and leads different verticals within the GPSS team, coaching them on Publicis Sapient initiatives, our core values and the body of human resources knowledge
* Creates localized vision and point of view for Shared Services that is consistent with the greater GPSS Organization
* Activity participates in interviewing and selecting new members of the Shared Services team (Associates & Senior Associates, including contractors)
* Drive continuous reviews and performance management for the team and report-out from time to time
* Build, implement and oversee Objectives & Key Responsibilities (OKRs) for the HR Shared Services team members
* Align with key stakeholders and partners from time to time to report out key metrics of Shared Services collaboration and performance
* Lead the change for the team and continuously work towards their capability development and engagement

**Operations and People Processes**

* Collaborate with support functions such as Hiring, Finance, HR Business Partners for a seamless execution of critical processes like Executive Integration Program (Leadership Level Onboarding), Client Specific Background Checks, etc.
* Work with Global HRSS & Technology Teams on system & tool enhancements in order to create streamlined processes
* Partners with other members of the People Success (HR) team to develop and implement policies, procedures, and practices surrounding people processes that represent innovative, best practices for the company
* Contribute in the designing of integration & lifecycle process frameworks that would include drafting & reviewing Standard Operating Procedures (SLAs) of key processes
* Ensure all the HRSS activities are done as per SLAs and timelines defined in the SOPs
* Monitor to see if all HR queries are responded on time in accordance with the SLAs
* Investigate incidents and take appropriate actions

**Communication:**

* Trains and coaches Senior Associates & Associates on ongoing and new people processes
* Assesses and counsels leaders in the appropriate resolution of team and employee relations issues
* Responds to escalations and inquiries regarding policies, procedures, and programs

**Company Contribution:**

* With other leaders, finds new and innovative ways to support the core values, creating ways to keep them vital for the organization
* Actively participates in delivering company-wide training programs if the need arises

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience**
**:**

* Stakeholder Management is critical and she/he must build strong relationships to partner with multiple teams within the organization
* Business orientation is crucial, thus should govern all people processes and initiatives in the organization.
* Strong written and verbal communication as well as interpersonal skills
* Team handling ability and maturity to drive difficult conversations and performance review of direct reports
* Ability to effectively present information to senior leadership, team, other employees and public groups
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
* Ability to interpret and extensive variety of instructions in verbal, written or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Windows (Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook), Strong customer service orientation
* Work collaboratively with Business and People Strategists, partner with individuals across different geographies
* Ability to maturely handle escalations and work pressure in demanding situations
* Ability to evaluate priorities and multi-task accordingly
* Ability to respond to grievances or concerns from employees and other relevant process stakeholders.
* Experience of working on any HR Information System (SAP, Oracle, Taleo, SharePoint, etc. preferably)

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* 8-10 years of professional work experience in HR (preferably as an HR generalist or HR manager)
* Demonstrated ability to manage others
* Worked in dynamic, fast-paced environments and must have worked in the IT industry.

Full-time

About MedsBee

MedsBee is a healthcare talent platform focused on helping hospitals, diagnostic centres and healthcare companies hire doctors across India.

We work across specialist hiring including Radiology, Critical Care, Internal Medicine and other clinical roles.

We're building MedsBee differently from a traditional recruitment agency — with a small, high-ownership team using technology, data, AI and strong execution to solve difficult healthcare hiring problems.

We're now looking for an
**Operations & Talent Generalist**
to work closely with the founder.

What will you actually do?

You will own healthcare hiring mandates from problem to outcome.

That means you may:

* Identify and reach out to doctors across India
* Speak with candidates and understand their requirements
* Find creative ways of sourcing candidates when traditional channels aren't working
* Screen and shortlist candidates
* Coordinate interviews and follow-ups
* Manage candidate pipelines and trackers
* Analyse why particular roles are difficult to close
* Research salaries, locations and talent markets
* Communicate with clients when required
* Experiment with new sourcing channels and tools
* Use AI, automation and data to make our recruitment process faster
* Help improve MedsBee's internal systems and processes

This is
**not a role where you will receive an SOP for every task**
.

Who are we looking for?

We're less concerned about your exact degree or previous job title and more interested in how you think and work.

You may be a good fit if you:

* Take ownership without needing constant follow-ups
* Are comfortable making calls and speaking with new people
* Are persistent without being pushy
* Can figure things out when instructions aren't clear
* Enjoy solving difficult problems
* Work quickly and stay organised
* Communicate clearly in English and Hindi
* Are comfortable with spreadsheets and technology
* Use or are interested in using AI tools
* Can handle rejection without losing momentum
* Don't consider any reasonable task "beneath your role"
* Prefer responsibility over rigid job descriptions

Recruitment experience is useful but
**not mandatory**
.

We are open to candidates from recruitment, sales, operations, healthcare, startups or other backgrounds if they demonstrate strong ownership and learning ability.

What this role is NOT

This may not be the right role if you:

* Prefer highly structured jobs with fixed responsibilities
* Need detailed instructions before starting every task
* Are uncomfortable making calls
* Measure success primarily by completing assigned activities
* Want a role limited strictly to recruitment or operations

What you'll get

* Direct exposure to the founder
* Responsibility from the beginning
* Opportunity to build systems rather than simply follow them
* Exposure to healthcare recruitment, operations, sales and technology
* Performance-linked incentives
* Opportunity to take significantly larger ownership as MedsBee grows

Compensation

₹25,000–₹35,000 per month depending on experience and capability + performance-linked incentives.

Exceptional candidates outside this range may also be considered.

title: Manager, Rewards -India, Middle East and Africa
description:
Role purpose
  
  
Shape how one of the world’s leading hotel companies rewards its people across India, the Middle East and Africa. As Manager, Reward – IMEA, you will translate IHG’s global reward strategy into market-relevant, cost-effective and compliant pay, incentive and benefit solutions across corporate offices, our Global Service Centre and hotels. It’s a hands-on, high-visibility role where your analysis and advice directly influence how we attract, retain and motivate great talent – while protecting internal equity, cost discipline and regulatory compliance.
  
  
**About Us**
IHG Hotels & Resorts is one of the world’s leading hotel companies with around 350,000+ colleagues working across more than 100 countries to deliver true hospitality for good. Our diverse portfolio of differentiated brands is well known and loved by millions of consumers around the world.
  
  
We genuinely care for our entire IHG Hotels & Resorts family. All our colleagues are valued, and their wellbeing matters to us. We provide the support our colleagues need to succeed and recognise them for their hard work. Our diverse global community values different perspectives and cultures.
  
  
Your day to day: key accountabilities
  
  

* Reward strategy, policy and governance
* Translate IHG’s global reward philosophy into a coherent IMEA reward framework, standardising policies across markets while reflecting local competitiveness and regulation.
* Own and maintain regional compensation and benefits policies and manuals across India, the Middle East and Africa, including allowance structures, keeping them current, consistent and well governed.
* Lead the reward response to regulatory change (e.g., India Labour Codes, Retirals, Flexible Benefits).
* Market intelligence, benchmarking and job architecture
* Lead annual salary survey participation (e.g., Mercer, Aon, WTW) and convert market data into salary ranges, pay structures and data-driven recommendations.
* Own pay benchmarking for corporate and hotel roles, including senior and executive positions, using compa-ratio, range penetration and pay-positioning analysis.
* Drive job evaluation, levelling and alignment to the global job architecture; partner on organisation design to ensure roles are sized consistently and fairly.
* Review offers, promotions and internal moves to ensure market competitiveness, internal equity and cost discipline.
* Annual reward cycles and incentives
* Lead end-to-end delivery of the annual merit and bonus cycles for IMEA corporate and hotels – from budget modelling and guidelines to pay tools, leader calibration and final sign-off.
* Partner closely with function leaders through each cycle to secure timely, well-reasoned and budget-aligned decisions.
* Analyse cycle outcomes (spend vs. budget, distribution, pay equity) and present clear insights to leadership.
* Hotel General Manager and Corporate hiring reward packages
* Manage reward for hotel General Managers across IMEA – including annual merit and bonus, hiring packages, benefit packages and compensation ranges – ensuring they are competitive and consistent.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition on corporate hiring, recommending market-competitive and internally equitable pay packages for new colleagues.
* Benefits and wellbeing
* Review and design benefit plans (e.g., medical and wellbeing, mobility, relocation and allowances) to ensure local competitiveness, compliance and alignment with IHG’s colleague wellbeing agenda.
* Lead renewals, tenders and evaluations with brokers and insurers; manage vendor performance and colleague escalations.
* Advisory, insight and communication
* Be the go-to reward partner for HRBPs, HR COEs and business leaders, giving clear, practical and commercially grounded advice.
* Turn complex reward analysis into crisp, decision-ready insights and leadership presentations.
* Design and deliver reward communications and education for leaders, managers and colleagues so programmes are understood and valued.

What we need from you
  
  
Whilst we love experience, mindset is of equal importance. We’re looking for a naturally analytical problem-solver who combines technical reward depth with commercial judgement and the confidence to influence senior leaders.
  
  

* 7+ years in Reward/Compensation and Benefits within a multinational and/or consultancy, ideally with multi-country scope across India and the Middle East.
* Strong knowledge of compensation and benefits principles, job evaluation and market pricing, with a working understanding of tax, social security and labour regulation (e.g., India Labour Codes, GCC labour law).
* Hands-on experience of annual merit and bonus cycles, incentive plans and hiring/offer pay recommendations.
* Advanced Excel and analytical skills – able to build accurate models and present them in executive-ready format.
* Experience with HR systems, reward tools and salary surveys (e.g., Oracle, Payfactors, Mercer, Aon, WTW).
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in both numerical and written work.
* Confident communicator and influencer who can challenge constructively and build trust with senior stakeholders.
* Hands-on, organised and delivery-oriented; comfortable owning work end to end as an individual contributor, managing multiple priorities and handling highly confidential information.

What we offer
  
  
At IHG we give our colleagues greater flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending remote and office working. Although we thrive on collaborating in person, we expect that you’re likely to spend time working remotely. Every role is different, and colleagues work with their team and their leader to determine how and when they collaborate in person. We like to believe we offer a unique culture where you have room to be yourself.
  
  
We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including impressive room discounts.
  
  
**Don’t quite meet every requirement but believe you’d be a great fit? We’d still love to hear from you – hit Apply and start your journey with IHG today.**
At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.
  
  
Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests & owners love.
  
  
We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.
  
  
We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.
  
  
Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other category protected by applicable laws. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
  
  
Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Group is responsible for the overall financial management of our company. This includes accounting, financial and regulatory reporting, balance sheet management, financial planning and analysis, treasury, investor relations, corporate investments and tax
  
  
Global Corporate & Investment Banking (GCIB) , Global Markets (GM), International Finance & Corporate Treasury strives to be a valued business partner to the company's trading, corporate, institutional & banking businesses and is responsible for funding the balance sheet, maintaining strong capital and liquidity positions, managing interest rate risk and overseeing company’s relationship with external stakeholders.
  
  
Our priority is to operate a series of key control processes to ensure the integrity of the group's financial results. Then we build on these activities to offer performance insight to business leaders.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Business Support manager is responsible for supporting day-to-day operations across GM, GCIB & International Finance and Treasury and driving execution of effective governance, technology enablement, policy adherence, and continuous improvement.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated Business Support Manager to support the COO organization in executing key business management and transformation priorities. The role will partner with GBS control & support functions like Finance, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to drive governance routines, technology adoption and ensure there are no KRI or KPI breaches. The role is instrumental in ensuring we remain compliant with all the policy and guidelines of GBS,
  
  
This role will also play a key role in supporting the HC forecast cycles in partnership with the LOB counterparts.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business priorities into actionable outcomes while maintaining a strong risk and control environment.
  
  
Key responsibilities include acting as a central point of contact for senior leadership routines and activities, financial control/budgeting and consolidation, personnel processes, audit/compliance, premises, associate training, service quality, process improvements, business continuity, and communications. Job expectations include interacting with a wide variety of business partners to deliver strategic work efforts to ensure tactical priorities are met.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drives successful execution of team events and routines, including logistics, communications and gathering feedback
* Develops comprehensive plans around key organizational priorities and ensures all accountable parties understand respective roles/responsibilities
