* Interactions on a daily basis with all levels of the organization, reviewing and gaining feedback on:
* Resource changes, on-boarding, off-boarding, reporting and metrics as well as reconciliation with central GMRT team reports
* Vendor management including A/P process, invoice payment and status, and forecasting
* General ad-hoc requests as needed for executive level meetings, business presentations, corporate communications, etc.
* Resource plans (forecast vs. actual)
* Quarterly business/organizational reviews (headcount ratios, hiring status, financials, etc.)
* Resource management (hiring requests and approvals, forecasting, on-boarding, mandatory training tracking, contract/contractor management)
* Operational Risk Management – Compliance coordination (mandatory training, etc.)
* Work with the PMs on developing their forecasts (resources, budget)

**Requirements\***

* Education\*

Graduate/ Post Graduate from Tier I/II institute with at least 8 yrs
  
  
**Experience Range**
7 to 8 years with at least 5 years’ experience in COO support role.
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Hands-on experience in delivering tasks related to COO, Transformation, Business Management or related functions.
* Experience managing cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders.
* Knowledge of process improvement methodologies, operational risk, controls, and governance frameworks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with proficiency in data analysis and management reporting.
* Experience supporting technology, automation, or AI-related initiatives.
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong Knowledge MS Office Suit including PowerPoint & Excel skills
* Ability to write effective prompts in AI Chat applications like Copilot
* Intellectual curiosity, regularly asking questions to enable rapid learning of a complex topic.
* Self-starter with ability to be proactive and well organized.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and relationship management skills
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels
* Attention to detail, analytical abilities/financial acumen/problem solving skills
* Strong control mindset including ability to identify risks and build and maintain associated controls
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a time-sensitive environment
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high-pressure environment

**Desired Skills**

* Knowledge SQL and awareness of AI tools
* Advanced experience/skills with Excel and complex spreadsheets
* Able to work both independently and as team member
* Strong problem solving and analytical abilities (Excel)

* Technical Business Analyst skills (SQL, VBA, Tableau, Alteryx, Python, AI/ML)Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner

**Role overview**

We are seeking an experienced Head of HR Operations to lead and continuously improve HR operations across our global organization, supporting approximately 700 employees. Based in India, this individual will have significant responsibility for our India operations while owning key HR processes, platforms, and operational capabilities globally. The ideal candidate combines strong HR operations expertise with a practical, hands-on approach to simplifying processes, using technology and automation effectively, and improving the experience of employees and managers.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working across countries, cultures, and time zones and who can build relationships, influence stakeholders, and drive change in a highly collaborative environment. We are particularly interested in someone who has operated successfully in a mid-sized, growing organization and is comfortable both developing scalable approaches and personally driving improvements.

Proactively develop and/or evolve core processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, benefits administration, engagement support, employee relations standards and governance, leave, documentation, offboarding, and associated strategic reporting and analysis

• Lead/own the configuration, optimization, governance, and ongoing administration of HR systems, workflows, and related HR infrastructure to ensure operating effectiveness

• Identify and implement opportunities to use HR technology, automation, self-service, analytics, and AI to improve efficiency and employee experience

• Provide strong operational leadership for HR activities in India while ensuring India operations are effectively integrated with global HR processes and practices

• Manage a distributed team and influence team members across regions to drive consistent practices and outcomes while enabling adaptation of processes to local market requirements and ensuring compliance with country-specific employment regulations and practices outside India

• Strengthen HR data quality, reporting, operational metrics, controls, documentation, and compliance

**Background and qualifications**

• Approximately 10–20 years of progressive HR experience, including significant experience in HR operations, technology, workflows, self-service, analytics and related areas.

• Significant experience working in global, mid-sized or growth-oriented organizations, ideally with responsibility for processes, teams, or initiatives spanning multiple countries and regions.

• Strong understanding of HR processes across the employee lifecycle and demonstrated experience simplifying and improving those processes.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, project management, communication, and change management capabilities, combined with a collaborative, hands-on approach to getting things done.

title: Manager- HRIS (SuccessFactors and HR Integrations)
description:
**Job Title:**
Manager - HRIS (SuccessFactors and HR Integrations)

**Department:**
Employee Experience (Function: DIT)

**Employment Type:**
Permanent

**Job Purpose:**

We are looking for a Manager to strategically manage, implement, and optimize the organization's Human Resources Information System (HRIS), specifically the SAP SuccessFactors platform. This role ensures robust and seamless integration with all internal and external HR and enterprise-level systems, thereby driving efficiency in HR operations and upholding data governance and integrity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **HRIS Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Governance (SAP SuccessFactors):**
  Formulate and govern the comprehensive HRIS product vision, strategic direction, and multi-year roadmap, focusing on the SAP SuccessFactors suite (including Employee Central, Learning, and Performance Management). Key activities include gathering and analyzing business requirements from HR stakeholders, prioritizing feature development based on strategic alignment and ROI, managing the product backlog, and enforcing system governance standards for data quality, security, and regulatory compliance.
* **Enterprise Solution Architecture, Configuration, and Optimization:**
  Direct the design, configuration, and continuous optimization of SuccessFactors modules to address current and future organizational needs. Responsibilities include translating business requirements into technical specifications, performing system configuration, managing testing cycles (Unit Testing and UAT), and resolving complex, escalated system incidents.
* **HR System Integration and Data Integrity Management:**
  Ensure the development and maintenance of seamless, stable, and secure integrations between SuccessFactors and enterprise systems (such as Financial ERP, Payroll platforms, and third-party vendors) utilizing middleware solutions like SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), IAS/IPS configurations, SuccessFactors integration center, SAP HCM to SF integration, and the BIB replication framework.
* **Cross-functional Stakeholder and Vendor Relationship Management:**
  Serve as the authoritative primary interface among Human Resources, Information Technology, end-users, and external consulting partners or vendors. This involves communicating roadmap updates, managing vendor contracts and service performance against SLAs, and providing expert consultation to the HR function.
* **Advanced Operational Support and Organizational Change Management:**
  Direct escalated L2 and L3 production support and spearhead formal Organizational Change Management (OCM) initiatives associated with deployments and upgrades. Responsibilities include establishing support protocols, managing bi-annual SuccessFactors release management processes, and developing professional training materials and documentation.



**Job Requirements:**

* **Academic Qualifications:**
  Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Human Resources, Business Administration, or an allied field. A Master’s degree (MBA, MIS) or professional HR certification (PHR, SHRM-CP) is preferred.
* **Experience:**
  A minimum of 8–10 years of progressively responsible experience within HRIS, IT, or HR functions, with at least 5 years explicitly dedicated to the management and implementation of SAP SuccessFactors modules (Employee Central expertise is mandatory). Candidates should also bring successful experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Solution Architect, along with demonstrated expertise in HR system integrations using middleware platforms like SAP Cloud Platform Integration/HCI or Dell Boomi.
* **Technical Skills & Knowledge:**
  Profound functional and technical command of SAP SuccessFactors (Employee Central plus 2–3 additional modules such as Compensation, Performance & Goals, Learning/LMS, Recruitment, or Onboarding 2.0). A robust comprehension of HR data models, security paradigms, international data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), integration protocols (APIs, SFTP, OData, SOAP), and practical experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* **Behavioral Skills:**
  Exceptional strategic acumen, advanced problem-solving capabilities, superior stakeholder management, negotiation, formal communication, leadership across cross-functional teams, vendor management, high accountability, and a strong results orientation.

The HR Executive will manage day-to-day HR activities including recruitment, employee onboarding, attendance, leave, payroll coordination, employee records, training, employee engagement, grievance handling, and exit formalities. The role will ensure that HR processes are completed accurately and on time while providing proper support to employees and managers. The HR Executive will also maintain updated HR records and support the company in building a disciplined, positive, and productive work environment.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage recruitment activities by understanding manpower requirements and coordinating with departments for hiring.
* Prepare and update Job Descriptions and publish approved openings on job portals and recruitment channels.
* Source and screen candidates through job portals, databases, agencies, and other suitable sources.
* Coordinate interviews with candidates, interview panels, and reporting managers.
* Collect interview feedback and communicate the next steps to selected candidates.
* Manage offer and joining formalities, including offer letters, joining dates, documents, and employee records.
* Coordinate employee onboarding and induction, including system access, workstation, policies, team introduction, and training.
* Monitor daily attendance and leave and ensure attendance records, missing punches, shifts, and leave approvals are updated.
* Coordinate payroll activities by providing accurate attendance, leave, deduction, and employee information to the Finance/Payroll team.
* Maintain employee documentation and HR records, including employee files, HR letters, registers, digital records, and compliance documents.
* Support employee performance, training, engagement, grievance, and discipline activities as required.
* Manage employee exit formalities, including resignation, exit interviews, clearance, full & final coordination, access removal, and record closure.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in HR, Business Administration, Management, or any relevant field.
* HR certification or relevant qualification will be an advantage.
* Freshers may apply if they have the right attitude and willingness to learn.
* Candidates with 1–3 years of HR experience will be preferred.
* Experience in recruitment, attendance, payroll coordination, or employee handling will be an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Good time management and follow-up skills.
* Ability to handle multiple HR activities at the same time.
* Good problem-solving and coordination skills.
* Basic computer and data management skills.
* Good attention to accuracy and confidentiality.
* Positive attitude and professional behaviour.
* Ability to communicate comfortably with employees, candidates, managers, and external agencies.

**Preferred Skills**

* MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* MS Word.
* Email and communication tools.
* HRMS / Attendance Management System.
* Job portals and recruitment databases.
* Google Drive / Shared folders.
* Basic knowledge of payroll and HR tracking systems.

title: Human Resources Business Partner - North & East
description: Job Summary:The HR Business Partner will be responsible for partnering with Operations and Store Leadership across the North & East region to drive effective people practices, employee engagement, performance, retention and employee relations. The role will own the employee lifecycle and ensure timely, consistent and compliant execution of HR processes across the region.Key Responsibilities:1. Employee Lifecycle Management• Manage end-to-end recruitment of manppower, induction, transfers and offboarding for employees across the region.• Ensure timely completion of joining formalities, documentation and exit processes.• Conduct exit interviews and analyse feedback to identify key attrition trends and improvement areas.• Filling the budget vs actuals for the store team and keep the fill rate percentage above 90% for your region at all times.2. Employee Relations & Grievance Management• Act as the primary HR contact for employee grievances and workplace concerns.• Investigate employee relations matters objectively by gathering facts, incident reports and relevant documentation.• Partner with Operations to arrive at appropriate resolutions.• Manage disciplinary processes and issue relevant warning, absconding, transfer and termination letters as required.• Maintain accurate documentation and ensure timely closure of employee cases.3. HR Business Partnering• Partner closely with the Operations Team, Area Managers and Store Managers on people related matters and business challenges.• Provide guidance on employee performance, attendance, discipline, engagement, retention and policy matters.• Conduct regular employee and stakeholder connects to proactively identify concerns.• Support managers in building a positive and high-performing store culture.4. Performance Management• Drive the Performance Management System across the region and ensure timely completion of all activities.• Support managers in setting expectations, providing feedback and managing performance.• Identify performance concerns and facilitate Performance Improvement Plans where required.• Monitor PIP progress and ensure appropriate documentation and closure.5. Employee Engagement & Retention• Drive regional employee engagement initiatives in alignment with the HR calendar.• Conduct employee connects and store visits to understand employee sentiment.• Analyse attrition and identify key retention challenges.• Partner with Operations to implement relevant retention and engagement interventions.• Do regular store visits – visit all the stores at least once in a quarter.6. HR Policy, Compliance & Governance• Ensure adherence to company HR policies and processes across all locations.• Guide employees and managers on HR policies and appropriate processes.• Identify policy deviations and ensure corrective action.• Maintain proper documentation and support HR audits and compliance requirements.7. HR MIS & Analytics• Maintain accurate employee records and HR trackers.• Prepare and analyse key HR reports covering headcount, attrition, absenteeism, hiring, exits, employee relations, PIPs and engagement.• Provide actionable insights to HR and Operations Leadership based on people data.KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIESFunctional: HR Business Partnering | Employee Relations | Performance Management | Employee Engagement | Retention | HR Operations | HR Policies & Compliance | HR Analytics & MISBehavioural: Strong communication | Stakeholder management | Problem-solving | Decision-making | Empathy | Ownership | Confidentiality | Conflict resolution | Attention to detail | Ability to work independentlyQUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE• MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent.• 3–6 years of relevant experience in HRBP, HR Operations, Employee Relations or Retail HR.• Experience managing employees across multiple locations/stores will be preferred.• Should be comfortable with travel across the assigned region as required.

title: Human Resource Manager- Hospital/Clinics
description:
**Designation: Human Resource Manager- Hospital/Clinics**

**Location: Delhi**

**Experience: 5–8 years of relevant HR experience, preferably with 2–3 years in a**

**managerial role.**

**Budget: 10 to 15 LPA**

**Qualification: MBA/PGDM/MHRM in Human Resources or equivalent**

**Preferred Experience: Healthcare, hospital, clinic or multi-location organization**

**experience will be an advantage.**

**About the Role**

The HR Manager will be responsible for managing and overseeing day-to-day HR operations, recruitment, manpower planning, employee relations, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, performance management, employee engagement and exit processes. The role will ensure effective implementation of HR policies, processes and applicable statutory requirements across assigned locations.

**Responsibilities**

* **HR Operations**
* Manage end-to-end HR operations for assigned locations and business functions.
* Ensure effective implementation of HR policies, processes and procedures.
* Monitor attendance, leave, late coming, regularization and employee discipline.
* Ensure proper maintenance of employee records and HR documentation.
* Handle escalated employee queries and grievances.
* Ensure timely completion of employee lifecycle activities.
* Coordinate with Centre Heads, Department Heads and reporting managers on HR matters.

* **Recruitment & Manpower Planning**
* Understand manpower requirements and prepare hiring plans in coordination with business heads.
* Manage end-to-end recruitment for clinical and non-clinical positions.
* Coordinate recruitment of doctors, clinical staff, centre operations, sales, administration and corporate positions.
* Manage recruitment consultants, job portals and other hiring sources.
* Conduct HR interviews and salary negotiations.
* Ensure timely closure of approved vacancies.
* Monitor recruitment status and hiring timelines.
* Maintain an effective candidate pipeline for critical positions.

* **Joining & Onboarding**
* Ensure smooth onboarding of new employees.
* Review joining documentation and ensure completion of required formalities.
* Coordinate background verification wherever applicable.
* Ensure employee records are created and updated in HRMS/GreytHR.
* Coordinate induction and orientation programs.
* Monitor probation periods and confirmation timelines.
* Ensure new employees receive appropriate HR support during onboarding.

* **Attendance & Payroll Coordination**
* Monitor attendance and leave records across assigned locations.
* Review attendance regularization and leave records.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with the Payroll/Finance team.
* Review salary-related inputs including attendance, leave, deductions and reimbursements.
* Coordinate resolution of employee payroll and salary-related queries.
* Review and coordinate Full & Final Settlement calculations and documentation.
* Ensure payroll inputs are accurate and submitted within defined timelines.

* **Statutory Compliance**
* Ensure timely compliance with applicable labour and employment laws.
* Coordinate and monitor statutory compliances including EPF/PF, ESI, Professional Tax (PT), Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), Shops & Establishments and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with Finance, payroll teams and external consultants for timely statutory filings, payments and returns.
* Maintain and review statutory records, registers and required documentation.
* Monitor statutory compliance calendars and ensure adherence to prescribed timelines.
* Identify compliance gaps and coordinate corrective actions.
* Keep Management/HR Head informed about significant compliance issues or changes in applicable regulations.
* Coordinate with statutory consultants and authorities wherever required.
* Ensure proper documentation is maintained for statutory inspections, notices and related matters.

* **Employee Relations & Grievance Handling**
* Handle employee grievances and workplace-related concerns.
* Investigate employee issues and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Maintain professional and positive employee relations.
* Support management in handling disciplinary and employee-related matters.
* Prepare/coordinate appropriate employee communications wherever required.
* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies and procedures.
* Escalate critical or sensitive matters to the HR Head/Senior Management.

* **Performance Management**
* Coordinate employee performance review and appraisal processes.
* Ensure KRAs/KPIs are defined and reviewed for employees.
* Monitor probation and performance review timelines.
* Support managers in addressing performance-related concerns.
* Coordinate Performance Improvement Plans wherever required.
* Identify employee training and development requirements.

* **Employee Engagement**
* Plan and coordinate employee engagement initiatives.
* Support employee recognition and appreciation activities.
* Coordinate employee communication and HR initiatives.
* Promote a positive and professional workplace culture.
* Gather employee feedback and recommend improvements.

* **Exit Management**
* Manage resignation and exit processes for assigned employees.
* Monitor notice periods and last-working-day formalities.
* Conduct or coordinate exit interviews.
* Ensure proper clearance and company asset recovery.
* Review Full & Final Settlement documentation.
* Coordinate issuance of relieving and experience letters.
* Maintain accurate employee separation records.

* **HR MIS & Reporting**
* Prepare and review periodic HR reports for HR Head and Management.
* Monitor head

title: Chief Human Resources Officer
description:
**We’re Hiring | Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)**

**Quick Clean Laundry Solutions | Gurugram, Haryana | Full-time | Leadership Role**

Build the Organisation. Develop Leaders. Drive Performance.

At Quick Clean, we are building more than a laundry services company. We are transforming how the hospitality and healthcare industries manage their laundry operations through technology, operational excellence, and sustainable solutions.

With 140+ On-Premise Laundry (OPL) sites across India, a workforce of 1,000+ employees, and ambitious expansion plans, we are entering an exciting new phase of growth.

We are looking for a Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) who can build the organisation, develop future leaders, strengthen our performance culture, and create the people infrastructure required to support our next phase of growth.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role working directly with the Founder & CEO. The mandate goes beyond traditional HR: we expect our CHRO to influence business performance through better leadership, workforce productivity, talent quality, and organisational effectiveness.

If you are passionate about building high-performance organisations and thrive in a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment, this opportunity is for you.

What Will You Own?

1. Organisation Strategy & Design

\* Partner with the Founder & CEO and leadership team to translate business objectives into a comprehensive people strategy.

\* Design scalable organisation structures, workforce plans, and reporting frameworks aligned with business growth.

\* Establish clear accountability, role ownership, and performance expectations across functions and locations.

\* Identify organisational capability gaps and build solutions to support rapid expansion.

2. Talent Acquisition & Workforce Planning

\* Build a robust recruitment engine to support leadership, sales, operations, engineering, and corporate hiring.

\* Develop manpower plans aligned with new-site launches, business expansion, and operational requirements.

\* Strengthen recruitment quality, hiring turnaround time, and onboarding effectiveness.

\* Build leadership pipelines, campus recruitment programmes, and management trainee initiatives.

\* Establish talent acquisition metrics covering hiring efficiency, quality of hire, and early-tenure retention.

3. Workforce Productivity & Operational HR

\* Partner with Operations and regional leadership to improve manpower availability, deployment, and productivity across our pan-India sites.

\* Develop workforce planning models covering staffing requirements, absenteeism, attrition, shifts, and overtime.

\* Establish productivity benchmarks and workforce management dashboards.

\* Strengthen HR engagement with frontline employees and operational teams through regular site visits.

\* Drive initiatives that improve workforce efficiency without compromising service quality, employee welfare, or safety.

4. Performance Management & Accountability

\* Build a high-performance culture through clear KRAs, measurable KPIs, quarterly reviews, and structured performance appraisals.

\* Align individual and functional performance with company objectives and business outcomes.

\* Establish transparent performance calibration, promotion, rewards, and performance improvement processes.

\* Work with business leaders to address sustained underperformance and strengthen managerial accountability.

\* Design performance-linked incentive and recognition frameworks that reward ownership, execution, and results.

5. Leadership Development & Succession Planning

\* Develop leadership capabilities across regional teams, functional heads, and operational site managers.

\* Build structured career progression, succession planning, and internal talent development programmes.

\* Identify high-potential employees and prepare them for larger responsibilities.

\* Coach managers to become stronger people leaders who can build capable, accountable teams.

\* Reduce dependence on external hiring by developing a strong internal leadership pipeline.

6. Employee Engagement, Retention & Culture

\* Strengthen Quick Clean’s culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, integrity, and customer focus.

\* Identify attrition drivers and develop targeted retention strategies for critical talent and frontline employees.

\* Build effective employee feedback, recognition, communication, and grievance-resolution mechanisms.

\* Improve managerial effectiveness, employee experience, and consistency of people practices across locations.

\* Develop initiatives that make Quick Clean an employer of choice for high-performing professionals.

7. HR Systems, Analytics & Governance

\* Build a data-driven HR function supported by effective HRMS utilisation, automation, and people analytics.

\* Establish dashboards covering attrition, recruitment, attendance, manpower costs, productivity, and performance.

\* Standardise HR processes across corporate offices, regional teams, and operational sites.

\* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements, employment policies, and workplace regulations.

\* Strengthen HR operations, payroll governance, documentation, and internal controls.

8. Compensation, Rewards & HR Team Leadership

\* Develop transparent compensation structures, salary bands, grading systems, and performance-linked rewards.

\* Ensure compensation decisions are aligned with performance, internal equity, market benchmarks, and business affordability.

\* Build and lead a high-performing HR team across talent acquisition, HR operations, business partnering, learning and development, and employee relations.

\* Establish clear HR team KPIs, service standards, and execution accountability.

\* Position HR as a strategic business partner rather than a purely administrative function.

What Are We Looking For?

Experience & Qualifications

\* 10–15 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3–5 years in a senior HR leadership or strategic HR business partnering role.

\* Demonstrated experience managing HR for a multi-location organisation with a geographically dispersed workforce.

\* Strong experience in talent acquisition, workforce planning, performance management, employee relations, and organisation development.

\* Experience working with frontline employees, site-based teams, and regional leadership.

\* Good understanding of Indian labour laws and multi-state HR compliance.

\* Experience building HR systems, dashboards, and measurable people processes.

\* A degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline. An MBA/PGDM in HR from a reputed institution would be preferred.

Preferred Background

Experience in one or more of the following sectors would be advantageous:

\* Hospitality and healthcare

\* Manufacturing and industrial services

\* Facilities management

\* Logistics and supply chain

\* Retail or other multi-location, service-intensive businesses

Experience in a founder-led, high-growth, entrepreneurial, or private-equity-backed organisation will be a strong advantage.

The Leadership Qualities We Value

We are looking for someone who:

\* Thinks like a business leader: Understands the relationship between people, productivity, revenue, and profitability.

\* Executes relentlessly: Converts ideas into measurable outcomes rather than stopping at policies and presentations.

\* Builds leaders: Develops managers who can take ownership and deliver results.

\* Makes tough decisions: Addresses performance issues with courage, fairness, and sound judgement.

\* Uses data to drive decisions: Relies on evidence, analytics, and measurable outcomes.

\* Stays close to the ground: Is comfortable engaging directly with frontline employees and visiting operational sites.

\* Thrives in a growth environment: Can bring structure and discipline without slowing down entrepreneurial execution.

What Does Success Look Like?

In the first 12 months, you will be expected to:

\* Build a scalable organisation structure aligned with Quick Clean’s growth ambitions.

\* Improve workforce planning and manpower productivity across operational sites.

\* Strengthen leadership capability and succession coverage for critical positions.

\* Establish a robust performance management and accountability framework.

\* Improve retention of high-performing and critical employees.

\* Build a dependable recruitment engine for business expansion.

\* Introduce reliable people analytics and HR dashboards for leadership decision-making.

\* Develop a capable HR team that delivers measurable business impact.

Specific targets will be agreed upon after an initial assessment of the organisation and its current performance baselines.

Why Join Quick Clean?

This is an opportunity to work directly with the Founder & CEO and play a defining role in building a high-growth Indian company.

You will have the opportunity to shape the organisation’s culture, develop its future leaders, influence business decisions, and build the people systems required for national and international expansion.

We value ownership, integrity, speed of execution, continuous improvement, and the courage to challenge the status quo.

We are not looking for someone to simply manage HR. We are looking for a leader who can help build the organisation that will take Quick Clean to its next level of growth.

Interested?

If you are ready to build, lead, and make a measurable difference, we would love to hear from you.

Manage complex employee relations matters, grievances, and disputes with sound judgement and discretion.

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; Master's degree or HR certification (e.g., SHRM, CIPD) is a MUST.
  
  
Minimum 10 12 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 5 years in a senior corporate HR leadership role (AGM, Head of HR, Regional HR Manager, or equivalent).
  
  
Proven track record of independently managing HR operations for multiple entities or projects across remote and international locations.
  
  
Strong knowledge of labor laws and familiarity with employment regulations in South Asia and other Middle Eastern markets.
  
  
Experience in healthcare, diagnostics, or service-oriented industries is an advantage.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing and optimizing manpower utilization in project-based or multi-entity corporate environments.

title: Senior Human Resources Manager
company: All India Institute of Occult Science
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – HR MANAGER

**Company:**
All India Institute of Occult Science

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Experience:**
4–5 Years

**Salary:**
₹4 LPA – ₹7.2 LPA

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
On-site

About the Role

All India Institute of Occult Science is looking for a result-oriented and technically strong HR Manager who can independently manage HR operations, payroll processing, statutory compliance, and employee-related matters. The ideal candidate must possess practical, execution-level knowledge of EPFO/PF compliance, ECR filing, PF challans, TDS, statutory returns, compliance audits, and EPFO notices.

We are looking for a professional who can take complete ownership of HR functions, resolve complex compliance issues, maintain accuracy in payroll, and ensure timely statutory submissions without excessive dependence on external consultants.

Key Responsibilities1. HR Operations & Employee Management

* Manage end-to-end HR operations, including onboarding, employee documentation, attendance, leave management, employee records, and exit formalities.
* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, HR policies, and workplace issues.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and ensure proper documentation.
* Coordinate with management on manpower planning, employee performance, and HR requirements.

2. Payroll Management

* Independently manage monthly payroll processing, including attendance validation, LOP calculations, salary revisions, arrears, deductions, and full-and-final settlements.
* Verify payroll inputs and ensure accurate salary calculations and timely salary disbursement.
* Reconcile payroll data with attendance records, employee master data, bank statements, and statutory deductions.
* Investigate and resolve salary discrepancies, incorrect deductions, and employee payroll complaints.
* Maintain payroll registers, salary statements, and supporting documentation.

3. EPFO / PF Compliance – Critical Requirement

* Independently manage monthly EPFO compliance, including PF calculations, ECR preparation, validation, and filing.
* Generate, verify, and reconcile PF challans and ensure timely payment of statutory dues.
* Handle UAN-related issues, employee PF complaints, missing contributions, and ECR errors.
* Reconcile payroll PF deductions with ECR records, challans, and applicable EPFO records.
* Investigate and resolve PF contribution mismatches and rejected ECR submissions.
* Handle EPFO notices, inspections, audits, queries, and related documentation.
* Coordinate with EPFO authorities and prepare appropriate responses and supporting records.
* Maintain accurate PF registers, employee contribution records, challans, returns, and compliance documentation.

4. TDS, Taxation & Other Statutory Compliance

* Manage or coordinate employee salary TDS calculations, declarations, investment proofs, tax projections, and year-end reconciliation.
* Review TDS deductions following salary revisions and changes in employee tax declarations.
* Coordinate timely TDS deposits, applicable returns, and related documentation.
* Ensure applicable ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, and other statutory obligations are met.
* Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and track filing dates, payments, returns, and acknowledgements.
* Identify compliance gaps, take corrective action, and minimise the risk of penalties or notices.

5. Compliance Audits & Management Reporting

* Prepare payroll and statutory records for internal audits, external audits, and government inspections.
* Maintain organised records of ECR filings, challans, payroll registers, TDS documents, and statutory returns.
* Prepare HR MIS reports covering payroll, employee strength, attendance, compliance status, and pending issues.
* Provide regular compliance updates to management and highlight risks with corrective action plans.
* Ensure that all applicable statutory obligations are completed accurately and within prescribed timelines.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in HR operations, payroll management, and statutory compliance.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience in EPFO/PF, ECR filing, PF challans, reconciliation, and employee PF matters.
* Practical exposure to EPFO notices, audits, inspections, and compliance-related queries.
* Strong working knowledge of salary TDS, payroll taxation, and applicable statutory filings.
* Experience in handling payroll discrepancies, statutory mismatches, and deadline-driven compliance issues.
* Good command of MS Excel, payroll systems, HR MIS, and compliance documentation.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and maintain strict confidentiality.

Mandatory Selection Criteria

**This position requires practical execution, not merely theoretical knowledge.**

**Candidates must be able to explain the actual steps they have personally performed for:**

* Monthly payroll processing and reconciliation.
* ECR preparation, validation, filing, and error resolution.
* PF challan generation, payment, and reconciliation.
* Resolving UAN issues and missing PF contributions.
* Handling EPFO notices, audits, and inspections.
* Salary TDS calculations and applicable statutory filings.

Candidates whose experience is limited to coordinating with consultants, forwarding documents, or having theoretical knowledge of payroll and PF compliance will not be suitable for this role.

Key Performance Expectations

* Accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Timely completion of applicable statutory filings and payments.
* Effective resolution of payroll and PF discrepancies.
* Proper maintenance of statutory records and audit documentation.
* Proactive identification and resolution of compliance risks.
* Independent ownership of HR operations and statutory compliance.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A technically sound HR professional who can independently manage HR operations, payroll, EPFO/PF compliance, TDS coordination, statutory documentation, and audit-related responsibilities while providing reliable support to management.

* **Apply Now:**
  Candidates with strong hands-on payroll and statutory compliance experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Founder's Office Intern
description:
We're hiring a
**Founder’s Office Intern**
at Neuroid

**Location:**
Ghitorni, New Delhi

**Setup:**
In-office (4 days WFO)

**Type:**
90-day paid internship | Converts to full-time on performance

Neuroid is a performance and content agency built for D2C brands - furniture, jewellery, skincare, apparel, F&B - managing ad spend in crores every month. We integrate performance marketing with content and creative, so the ads and the assets behind them are built to work together, not handed across a wall.

This is a generalist seat next to the founder. One week you’re screening media buyer applications, the next you’re reconciling invoices in Zoho, the next you’re cutting a reel script down to 40 seconds. If you want a job title that fits on a business card, this isn’t it. If you want to see how a 20-person agency actually runs - money, people, content, clients - from the inside, in 90 days, it is.

**What you’ll do**

* Hiring and people: post roles, screen applications, schedule interviews, prepare offer letters and onboarding checklists, keep HR records current, run the first-week experience for every new joiner
* Finance and billing: raise invoices in Zoho Books, track what’s paid and what’s overdue, prepare the weekly receivables sheet, log expenses, chase documents from vendors and clients
* Agreements: fill client and employment agreements from our templates, track what’s signed, what’s pending and what renews when
* Content: sit in on the founder’s content planning, research topics, draft and tighten scripts and posts, keep the idea bank and posted log current, give an honest opinion on what’s good
* AI: find and test tools that make any of the above faster, and build the small automations yourself - sheets, Zapier, prompts, whatever works
* Whatever the founder’s office needs that week

**Who this is for**

* A final-year student or recent graduate, or someone 0 to 1 year in, who has already run something - a college fest, a society, a small business, a freelance practice - and can show the mess they cleaned up
* You’re comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets and don’t need to be asked twice to follow up
* You read, you write clearly, and you have taste - you know why one caption works and another dies, and you can say it without being asked
* You’ve used AI tools for real work, not just to write assignments, and you’re curious about what else they can do
* You’re organised to the point of being slightly annoying about it
* Available full-time, in-office at Ghitorni (3rd Floor, 354, 100ft Road, near Ghitorni metro), starting November

**What you get**

* A seat in the founder’s office of a 30+ client agency, with real exposure to hiring, finance, legal, content and clients in one stint
* A written review at day 45 and a full-time offer at day 90 if you’ve earned it
* Direct mentorship from the founder and the Head of Ops
* More context on how an agency makes and loses money than most people get in two years

**How to apply**

Email hr@neuroidmedia.com with the subject “Founder’s Office Intern”. Three lines on one thing you organised or fixed and what changed because of it, plus one piece of content you’ve made that you’re proud of. No cover letters.

title: Head of Human Resources
description:
HEAD OF HR

**Faridabad, Delhi NCR | On-site | 12–18 years | Reports to the founders**

We're 300+ people across three countries, opening three more, and hiring close to twenty specialist roles at once. Our people systems were built for a smaller, simpler company.

This role has two halves, and we need both.

**Half one: factory HR in India, where the statute just changed.**
The four Labour Codes came into force in November 2025, replacing 29 central laws — the Factories Act, Contract Labour Act, Industrial Disputes Act and the EPF and ESI legislation among them. Haryana has notified its rules. Most HR functions are still running on habits built for a framework that no longer exists.

**Half two: a company growing faster than its systems.**
New countries, new functions, new seniority levels — org design decisions being made by default rather than deliberately.

**The problem nobody warns you about**

We're hiring specialists who have no peer group here. A colour management specialist. A Mandarin-speaking supplier liaison. A tooling engineer for sub-millimetre cosmetic parts. In most cases they'll be the only person in the building doing that job, with no internal career ladder and no local market to move within.

Standard retention thinking doesn't work on those people. Working out what does is one of the more interesting problems in this role.

**What you'd build**

* A compliance framework built on the Labour Codes as they now stand, not inherited practice — registers, returns, registrations, audit trail
* Contract labour governance that actually protects us as principal employer, rather than a file of contractor certificates nobody has verified
* Org design and workforce planning as we open Germany, Australia and the UK
* A compensation structure that can hold specialists paid above band without the whole thing coming apart
* Retention that works for people without a peer group, and for operators, who leave for entirely different reasons
* Performance and grievance processes that hold up when they're tested
* Onboarding that gets an operator productive and safe faster

**You'd own**

* Statutory compliance across the plant, and the government liaison that goes with it
* Industrial relations, grievance handling and disciplinary process
* The HR function and its team, including talent acquisition
* Payroll, attendance, shift and overtime governance
* POSH Internal Committee, safety committee, welfare
* Employment structures as new entities open, working with advisers

**You need**

* 12+ years in HR with
  **real manufacturing depth.**
  Not a corporate HR head who has visited a plant — the compliance and IR load here is a different job and services backgrounds don't transfer
* Working knowledge of the
  **Labour Codes and the Haryana rules**
  , and a clear view of what changed
* **Contract labour management**
  , with real understanding of principal employer liability
* IR capability: grievance, enquiry, disciplinary process, and the judgement to de-escalate
* **Demonstrated scaling**
  — org design, workforce planning, building structure where there wasn't any
* Led an HR team, not just an HR process
* Fluent Hindi. Much of this role happens in Hindi
* Multi-country or multi-entity exposure a strong plus

**Tell us:**
one compliance gap you found and closed, one IR situation you handled that could have gone badly, and one thing you built that let the company grow without breaking.

**Role Overview**

**We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Plant HR professional to establish, implement and independently lead the complete Human Resources, Industrial Relations and Administration function at our manufacturing facility in Manesar, with a workforce of approximately 101–200 staff.**

**This is a function-building role**
, requiring someone who can develop HR policies, establish statutory compliance processes, manage shop-floor manpower, implement HR systems and create a structured, disciplined and employee-focused work environment.

The ideal candidate should have practical manufacturing experience and the confidence to manage HR operations independently while working closely with plant leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Establish the HR Function from Scratch**

* Design and implement HR policies, SOPs, procedures and employee documentation systems.
* Establish recruitment, onboarding, confirmation, attendance, leave, payroll and exit processes.
* Develop employee handbooks, appointment letters, job descriptions, reporting structures and performance frameworks.
* Evaluate and implement a suitable HRMS, biometric attendance and payroll system.
* Create HR dashboards, employee databases and compliance monitoring systems.
* Establish a structured HR operating model aligned with the factory's manpower and production needs.

**2. Plant HR & Workforce Management**

* Manage HR activities for permanent, contractual, technical and shop-floor employees.
* Plan manpower requirements in coordination with production, maintenance, quality and other departments.
* Lead recruitment of operators, technicians, supervisors and managerial staff.
* Manage workforce deployment, shifts, attendance, overtime, leave and absenteeism.
* Develop strategies to reduce employee turnover and improve workforce stability.
* Implement performance monitoring, employee communication and disciplinary processes.

**3. Industrial Relations & Statutory Compliance**

* Establish compliance processes under applicable Central and Haryana labour laws and the four Labour Codes.
* Oversee PF, ESIC, wages, gratuity, bonus, leave, working hours and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Conduct a baseline audit of current statutory registrations, licences, records and compliance gaps.
* Maintain relevant registers, documentation, statutory returns and compliance calendars.
* Coordinate with labour authorities, statutory consultants and external auditors.
* Manage employee grievances, disciplinary proceedings, disputes and worker relations.
* Ensure proper documentation and compliance for all contract labour arrangements.
* Support statutory, customer and third-party compliance audits.

**4. Contract Labour & Payroll Management**

* Manage relationships with manpower contractors and staffing agencies.
* Monitor contractor manpower deployment, attendance, wage payments and compliance.
* Establish payroll approval and verification processes in coordination with Finance.
* Ensure timely processing of salaries, statutory deductions and benefits.
* Track manpower costs, overtime expenditure and contractor billing.
* Introduce controls to minimise payroll errors and prevent non-compliance.

**5. Employee Engagement, Training & Performance**

* Establish employee induction, orientation and communication programmes.
* Design performance appraisal and review processes for different employee categories.
* Identify training requirements jointly with production and departmental heads.
* Coordinate technical, behavioural, supervisory and compliance training.
* Establish employee grievance and feedback mechanisms.
* Implement practical initiatives to improve retention, productivity and workplace discipline.

**6. Factory Administration & Welfare**

* Coordinate administration of security, housekeeping, canteen, transport and employee welfare facilities.
* Develop service standards and monitor administrative vendors.
* Work with the EHS function to support employee safety, awareness and welfare compliance.
* Establish policies and mechanisms for POSH, workplace conduct and grievance redressal.
* Coordinate with factory management on employee facilities and welfare improvements.

**7. Management Reporting & HR Governance**

* Prepare monthly HR MIS covering employee headcount, hiring, attrition, absenteeism, overtime, manpower costs and compliance.
* Establish and track measurable HR KPIs.
* Provide management with recommendations on workforce planning and HR risks.
* Support organisation development and manpower planning as operations expand.

description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Performance and Reward Consulting**
.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
The Performance and Reward Consultant provides insight-led consulting and decision support across performance and reward. Based in Hyderabad, the role will initially support activities across Europe, working with Performance and Reward Partners, Country People Heads and specialist colleagues to deliver high-quality advisory and selected operational support.
  
  
The role translates policy, analytics and market information into clear options and recommendations, supports cyclical processes and strengthens standardisation, control and continuous improvement. As priorities evolve, the role may rotate across geographies, stakeholder portfolios, products, processes and projects.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Provide guidance, constructive challenge and technical knowledge across performance, compensation and related Performance and Reward matters, interpreting policy and seeking specialist input where required.
* Support cyclical processes, including year-end performance and pay review, market data, pay equity reviews, fixed pay range reviews, variable pay reviews and other activities within scope.
* Translate analytics, internal data, market information and emerging trends into clear narratives, options, recommendations and decision-ready insights.
* Build and maintain standard management information using agreed definitions and templates, including performance distributions, pay outcomes, expenditure against budget, population eligibility and internal equity views.
* Undertake targeted analysis, scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis; identify anomalies, pay compression, outliers and variances from policy norms; and propose appropriate questions or actions.
* Prepare stakeholder engagement materials and leadership-ready packs; simplify complex Performance and Reward topics into clear messages; and contribute to governance papers, committee materials, regulatory reporting and external disclosures where required.
* Manage the day-to-day execution of reward programmes and complex queries, working with Performance and Reward Partners, Country People Heads, Analytical and Operational Associates and specialist teams to validate data, reconcile inputs and outputs, document exceptions and ensure effective hand-offs.
* Maintain decision traceability and a strong control environment by recording assumptions, data sources, methodologies and outcomes; identifying and escalating risks promptly; improving playbooks, templates, training, documentation and data dictionaries; automating repeatable reporting where possible; and contributing to knowledge sharing, cross-training and continuous improvement.

**To be successful you will:**

title: Asia Pacific Regional Consulting L&D Senior Manager
description:
**Locations**

Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As AP Regional Consulting L&D Manager/ Senior Manager, you will play a pivotal role in delivering BCG’s learning strategy in AP and playing a business partner role for selected cohorts/ strategic initiatives.
  
  
You will ensure seamless run-the-business (RTB) execution of selected core journeys, escalate areas of improvement or new skills gaps/ learning needs to global Learning journey owners, maintain proximity to the business and act as a business partner to regional & system stakeholders to ensure relevance and impact in the AP region.
  
  
By networking with other regional and global counterparts, you will lead or actively participate in journey improvement projects, such as updating learning modules, enhancing journey linkages, measuring impact, and integrating topics across journeys.
  
  
At the journey level, you will also contribute to strategic vendor relationship management, new facilitator onboarding / upskilling and feedback in the AP region.
  
  
The role also works closely with the AP Consulting L&D Senior Director as well as the local L&D teams across AP, to shape and execute on AP L&D strategic priority projects, to address the business/ people needs specific to AP region, and share updates and impact regularly with AP L&D leadership team and relevant project sponsors.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 8–10 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in learning & development, talent development, or a related field in a complex or global organization.
* Proven ability to work across geographies and cultures, with experience navigating matrixed environments and collaborating with senior stakeholders.
* Very strong influencing, networking and relationship building skills
* Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and deliverables with a high level of autonomy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft clear, compelling messages and adapt content to different audiences.

* Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-changing environments and collaborating effectively across diverse teams to drive alignment and shared outcomes.

* AP L&D Leadership Team

* Global Learning Journey Owners

* Other AP business leaders

* Managing a diverse set of stakeholders by balancing priorities, driving alignment, and engaging with empathy and credibility across all levels.
* Communicating with clarity, professionalism, and presence in both written and verbal formats, effectively influencing decisions and engaging local, regional & global audiences.
* Taking ownership from concept to execution, ensuring high-quality outcomes through strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail.

title: Enablement / Copilot Coordinator
description:
**Position Title:**
Enablement / Copilot Coordinator
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
43620
  
  
**Overview**
Our Digital Technology team helps employees leverage technology to work more effectively, collaborate better, and deliver greater business value. As McCain continues to expand the use of Microsoft Copilot, AI tools, automation, and modern workplace technologies, effective adoption and user enablement are critical to realizing business value.
  
  
The Enablement & Copilot Coordinator supports the successful rollout, adoption, and ongoing use of Microsoft Copilot and other productivity technologies. This role works closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, trainers, and employees to coordinate communications, training activities, adoption campaigns, user feedback, and reporting.
  
  
The successful candidate is a highly organized and proactive professional who combines technology curiosity, strong communication skills, and change management capabilities to help employees confidently adopt new ways of working.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Enablement & Copilot Coordinator is responsible for coordinating employee enablement activities that drive awareness, adoption, and effective use of Microsoft Copilot and related digital workplace tools.
  
  
This role serves as a key liaison between technology teams and end users, ensuring employees have access to training, resources, communications, and support needed to successfully embrace new capabilities. The position focuses on execution, coordination, user engagement, and continuous improvement rather than technical development.
  
  
**Key Responsibilites**
**Copilot Adoption & Enablement**

* Support enterprise deployment and adoption initiatives for Microsoft Copilot and other AI-enabled productivity tools.
* Coordinate enablement activities that help employees understand and effectively use new capabilities.
* Assist with rollout planning, readiness activities, and adoption campaigns.
* Identify adoption barriers and escalate opportunities for improvement.
* Support business units during onboarding and early adoption phases.

**Training & Learning Coordination**

* Coordinate training sessions, workshops, office hours, and learning events.
* Schedule presenters, manage attendance tracking, and support logistics.
* Maintain learning content, quick-reference guides, FAQs, and user resources.
* Assist with the creation of role-based learning materials and enablement content.
* Promote continuous learning and skills development across the organization.

**Communications & User Engagement**

* Develop and coordinate communications related to Copilot adoption and digital workplace initiatives.
* Create newsletters, announcements, success stories, and awareness campaigns.
* Support employee communities, collaboration channels, and engagement forums.
* Help showcase practical use cases and adoption success examples.

**Adoption Analytics & Reporting**

* Track participation, engagement, and adoption metrics.
* Maintain dashboards, reports, and status updates for stakeholders.
* Analyze user feedback and identify trends, opportunities, and challenges.
* Assist leaders in understanding adoption progress and areas requiring additional focus.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Partner with business teams, Digital Technology teams, HR, Communications, and Learning teams.
* Coordinate stakeholder meetings and follow-up activities.
* Maintain project plans, action logs, and implementation schedules.
* Support change management and business readiness activities.

**User Feedback & Continuous Improvement**

* Gather employee feedback regarding Copilot experiences and enablement programs.
* Help identify recurring issues, questions, and enhancement opportunities.
* Escalate improvement recommendations to appropriate technology teams.
* Contribute to ongoing refinement of adoption programs and learning experiences.

**Governance & Responsible Use**

* Promote responsible and secure use of AI technologies.
* Support awareness of privacy, security, compliance, and governance requirements.
* Ensure enablement materials align with company policies and standards.

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS**

* Increased adoption and usage of Microsoft Copilot and related productivity tools.
* High participation rates in enablement and learning programs.
* Positive employee feedback regarding training and support experiences.
* Timely execution of adoption campaigns and communications.
* Accurate and actionable adoption reporting.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction and collaboration.
* Effective promotion of responsible AI practices.

**Job Qualifications & Experience**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Communications, Learning & Development, Human Resources, or a related field.

**Experience**

* 2-5 years of experience in technology enablement, learning coordination, change management, digital workplace programs, project coordination, training, communications, or related disciplines.
* Experience supporting organizational technology adoption initiatives preferred.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and Power Platform, is desirable.
* Exposure to Microsoft Copilot, AI tools, or digital transformation initiatives is an asset.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Comfortable presenting information and facilitating learning sessions.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret adoption data and feedback.
* Customer-focused approach with a passion for helping others succeed.
* Curiosity about emerging technologies and AI-enabled productivity tools.

**Other Information**

* Individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities.
* Suitable for an early-to-mid career professional with some experience coordinating programs, training, adoption, or change initiatives.
* Provides a development path toward Enablement Lead, Change Lead, Adoption Lead, Digital Workplace Lead, or AI Deployment & Enablement roles.
* Occasional flexible hours may be required to support global training sessions and adoption activities.
* Expected to model strong ethical judgment and responsible use of AI technologies.

description:
**Immediate Joining Only**

If you're offered a seat on a rocket ship, don't ask what seat!

- Sheryl Sandberg

**About Rostrum Education**

Rostrum Education supports students and families in their journey to gain admission to the world’s most competitive universities. With personalised mentorship, expert guidance, and a proven track record, we help students craft strong, standout applications.

In the 2025 admissions cycle, our students secured 10+ Oxbridge offers and 15+ Ivy League offers, showcasing the strength of our strategies and the quality of our mentorship. From Oxford to Harvard, Cambridge to Columbia, we help ambitious students turn their aspirations into achievement.

With Rostrum, students benefit from a strategy that can increase their chances of admission up to 5 times, helping them turn their ambition into achievement and applications into success stories.

Dive into the full story: https://rostrumedu.com/

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a driven and hands-on Senior HR Associate who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. This role requires someone who takes complete ownership of HR processes, is proactive in problem-solving, and is comfortable operating in a dynamic, evolving setup. This position handles employee recruitment, onboarding, benefits administration, performance management, and employee relations. You will be responsible for developing and updating HR policies, ensuring legal compliance, and supporting organizational culture and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic Management in HR:**
  Partner with leadership to translate business goals into people strategies covering workforce planning, headcount and budgeting, talent retention, and culture-building; use HR data and analytics to advise on organizational structure and decisions, and proactively identify people-risks and opportunities to shape long-term HR strategy
* **Policy & Compliance:**
  Draft, review, and implement HR policies in alignment with organizational needs and legal requirements, ensuring 100% communication and documentation of updates; maintain a centralized policy repository and conduct periodic reviews to ensure relevance, clarity, and compliance
* **Performance Management:**
  Implement and drive KRA/KPI frameworks across teams, ensure timely completion of performance review cycles, coordinate with stakeholders for evaluations, and maintain accurate performance records to support data-driven decision-making
* Employee Engagement & Relations: Strengthen employee experience by conducting regular check-ins, feedback surveys, and engagement initiatives; analyze feedback data to identify trends and gaps, present actionable insights to management, and drive initiatives that enhance workplace culture, collaboration, and employee satisfaction
* **Payroll, Attendance & Benefits:**
  Manage and validate monthly attendance, resolve discrepancies prior to payroll processing, and execute accurate payroll through HRMS tools (e.g., Keka); ensure timely salary disbursement, maintain payroll records, and administer employee benefits including insurance, leave, and wellness programs while addressing employee queries
* **Learning & Development:**
  Identify training and development needs through performance insights and feedback, design and implement structured learning initiatives, and facilitate training sessions and workshops to drive continuous learning, skill enhancement, and employee growth
* **HR Operations:**
  Oversee the complete employee lifecycle including reference checks, onboarding documentation, employee records management (HRMS and physical), internal transfers, and exits, while ensuring process efficiency, accuracy, and continuous improvement; act as the first point of contact for employee queries and grievances, ensuring timely and effective resolution
* **End-to-End Employee Lifecycle Management:**
  Own and manage the complete employee journey, from offer acceptance and pre-boarding through onboarding, confirmation, career progression, internal mobility, and exit, as a single point of accountability; coordinate across recruitment, operations, payroll, and L&D at each milestone, and use lifecycle data to continuously improve the employee experience and flag retention risks early
* **Recruitment & Onboarding:**
  Manage the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle including Job Description creation, candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, assessments, and offer rollout, while maintaining a structured hiring pipeline and ensuring a seamless, positive candidate experience; design and execute a well-structured onboarding program that enables smooth integration of new hires into the organization’s culture, values, and workflows

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field
* Mandatory 4-5 years of hands-on HR experience across HR operations, Talent Acquisition and People Management
* Strong understanding of HR processes, systems, and best practices
* Familiarity with employment laws and compliance requirements
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-ownership, and dynamic environment

**Why Join Us?**

* Join a globally recognized and fast-growing organization in the education sector.
* Work in a dynamic, cross-functional team environment.
* Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.
* Exposure to international clients and projects with impact.
* Opportunities for professional development and advancement.

**Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**

At Rostrum Education, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of race, religion, gender, nationality, disability, or sexual orientation.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**HR Manager**

**﻿**

**Talent Acquisition & People Operations Delhi NCR | Full-time | 5-8 years preferred | Reports to Founder / Leadership**

**Build the team. Build the systems.**

Dr. Morepen Home delivers doctor visits, nursing care, vaccinations, IV therapy, diagnostics and ongoing care at home. We also operate institutional health centres. We are looking for an HR Manager who has worked in a fast-paced startup and can independently own hiring and people operations as we grow.

You should have personally hired both tech and non-tech talent, managed an HRMS, implemented policies and used AI to improve day-to-day execution. This is a hands-on individual ownership role, with scope to build the function over time.

**Recruitment and workforce planning**

• Partner with founders and managers to define role requirements, hiring priorities, compensation ranges and interview plans.

• Own sourcing, screening, interviews, references, offers and joining across technology, product, sales, growth, operations, support and clinical teams.

• For tech hiring, understand role requirements, conduct effective initial screens and coordinate technical assessments with hiring managers.

• Build direct sourcing pipelines through LinkedIn, referrals, communities, job platforms and targeted outreach; use agencies selectively.

• Manage multiple live roles, share weekly pipeline updates and proactively resolve interview delays, offer drop-offs and joining risks.

• Track time to fill, offer acceptance, actual joins, sourcing mix and 90-day retention. Balance speed with hiring quality.

**Onboarding and employee lifecycle**

• Own joining documentation, induction, probation tracking, confirmations, role changes and exits.

• Coordinate background checks and clinical credential verification with medical leadership before deployment.

• Give new hires clear responsibilities, reporting lines, goals and check-ins; support managers through the first 90 days.

**Own HR operations**

Practical systems, clear policies and accountable execution.

**HRMS, payroll coordination and policies**

• Independently administer the HRMS: employee records, attendance, leave rules, approval flows, onboarding, exits, reporting and access permissions.

• Coordinate accurate monthly payroll inputs with finance, including attendance exceptions, new joiners, exits and approved incentives.

• Draft, implement and explain policies covering leave, attendance, conduct, reimbursements, confidentiality and performance.

• Coordinate applicable employment and statutory requirements with finance, legal advisers and external specialists; maintain organised documentation.

**Performance, employee relations and retention**

• Set up probation reviews, role-specific goals, feedback cycles and documented performance improvement plans.

• Resolve employee concerns fairly, support managers with difficult conversations and follow through on agreed actions.

• Analyse early exits, recurring absenteeism and retention concerns; recommend practical improvements.

**Use AI and automation in daily work**

• Use AI for sourcing research, search strings, role briefs, interview guides, policy drafts and reporting, with human review.

• Build useful automations for interview coordination, onboarding reminders, probation alerts and recurring HR reports.

• Show measurable improvements in turnaround time or administrative effort. Use approved tools and protect candidate and employee information.

**What you should bring**

• Typically 5-8 years in recruitment and HR, including at least 2 years in a fast-paced startup or comparable scaling business.

• Evidence of personally closing both tech and non-tech hires, managing simultaneous vacancies and working directly with founders or business heads.

• Hands-on HRMS administration and policy implementation experience, beyond data entry or forwarding issues to a vendor.

• Practical AI skills, strong Excel or Google Sheets ability, clear English and Hindi communication, discretion and dependable follow-through.

description:

Luxolis is an innovative technology company specializing in AI-powered computer vision, robotics, industrial automation, and intelligent inspection systems.

Our technologies combine Vision-Language Models (VLMs), spatial intelligence, and advanced robotic systems to enable smarter and more efficient industrial operations.

As we expand our international engineering and business teams, we are seeking a dedicated and highly organized

* Develop and maintain internal HR policies in accordance with applicable employment laws.
* Coordinate employment compliance matters with external legal counsel and labor specialists.

* Support employment contract reviews, workplace investigations, and regulatory inquiries.

* Strong understanding of employee administration, employment contracts, payroll coordination, and HR procedures.

title: Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP)
description:
Job description

The HR acts as a
**strategic advisor**
to business leaders, ensuring HR policies and practices support organizational objectives. They serve as a
**liaison between HR and management**
, balancing employee advocacy with business needs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Strategic alignment**
  : Partner with leadership to design HR strategies that drive business success.
* **Talent management**
  : Support recruitment, succession planning, and career development.
* **Employee relations**
  : Advise managers on workplace issues and conflict resolution.
* **Performance management**
  : Facilitate goal-setting, reviews, and productivity improvement.
* **Change management**
  : Guide teams through restructuring, mergers, or new initiatives.
* **Policy development**
  : Review and update HR policies to align with company goals.
* **Compliance**
  : Ensure adherence to labor laws and HR regulations.
* **Payroll management**

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of
  **HR practices, labor laws, and compliance**
  .
* Excellent
  **communication and interpersonal skills**
  .
* Ability to act as a
  **trusted advisor**
  to senior leaders.
* Fintech, NBFC OR Financial services experience is more preferred.
* Experience in
  **talent development, workforce planning, and organizational culture**
  .
* Analytical skills for
  **HR metrics and workforce analytics**
  .
* Requires a
  **Bachelor’s/Master’s in HR or Business Administration**
  plus atleast 2 years of HR experience.
