title: Manager, HR Operations
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
  
  
Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
  
  
**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
Join our
**People Services & Solutions team**
as a
**Manager, HR Operations**
and lead the delivery of high‑quality, scalable HR services across the Globe.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
In this role, you will lead and develop a team of HR Operations professionals based in Gurgaon, overseeing day‑to‑day HR service delivery and driving continuous improvement across processes, systems, and controls. The role ensures consistent, compliant HR operations aligned with local employment practices and also serves as the on-site supervisor for a global HR operations team serving the US, Asia and EMEA.
  
  

* Manage and develop an HR Operations team, promoting a strong service‑delivery, employee‑experience mindset, and operational excellence.
* Drive process standardization, documentation, and optimization. Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and scale HR processes.
* Partner closely with People Business Leaders, Centers of Excellence (COEs), Payroll, Benefits, Technology, and external vendors supporting business needs while maintaining operational consistency.
* Act as an escalation point for complex HR operational issues and employee queries across multiple countries.
* Maintain strong employee data integrity, support audits and internal controls, and manage operational risk across the region.
* Lead end‑to‑end local HR operational processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, employee changes, compensation updates, leave administration, and offboarding.
* Ensure HR transactions are executed accurately, consistently, and in compliance with local labor laws, consultation obligations, and regional employment practices.

**What You Will Bring**

* 6–8+ years of experience in HR operations roles within a global or multinational organization including support of India.
* Solid understanding of Iabour laws, local employment practices, and regional compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated success in driving process improvement and operational change.
* Strong operational and analytical capability, with excellent attention to detail and a focus on accuracy and risk management.

title: HR Manager
description:
**What We Can Achieve Together**
The Human Resources Manager provides human resource services in one or more of the following functions: employee relations, compensation, talent management, benefits, payroll, staff development and training, organizational development and recruiting. The Human Resources Manager is responsible for administering and maintaining HR systems, programs, procedures and plans according to HR policies and will provide assistance to all levels of personnel on various HR-related issues and requests.
  
  
**We’re Looking For You**
Are you looking for work you can believe in? At TNC we strive to embody a philosophy of Work that You Can Believe in where you can feel like you are making a difference every day. We’re looking for someone with experience in working with a diverse, multi-disciplinary team across many different programs. The ideal candidate should have exceptional communication and collaboration skills and experience designing, organizing, and directing complex projects. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the ongoing mission of conservation by directing and shaping the work of our team!
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree or a minimum of 5 years related work experience in area(s) of specialization or equivalent combination.
* Experience coordinating and leading projects.
* Experience responding to HR related questions and problems from employees/management.
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: database management and spreadsheet software; constructing and producing reports; data input, manipulation, and analysis.
* Experience working with MS Office software, including Word, Excel, Teams, and PowerPoint

**Desired Qualifications**

* Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience appreciated.
* Advanced understanding of fundamental HR concepts, processes, and services.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* May require fluency in foreign language(s) to support global operations.
* Ability to travel.

**Who We Are**
The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.
  
  
One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”
  
  
**What We Bring**
Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!
  
  
TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.
  
  
We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.
  
  
Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.
  
  
**Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.**
The Nature Conservancy is an
**Equal Opportunity Employer.**
Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.
  
  
The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.
  
  
TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to applyhelp@tnc.org with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

title: Sr Director Analyst (HR Strategy & Transformation)
description:
**About the role:**
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.
  
  
A Senior Director possesses a keen eye for identifying gaps, problems and solutions within the market they serve. They use their knowledge to help clients make better decisions, solve complex issues and execute new practices that propel clients’ businesses toward key objectives and publish these pragmatic and/or provocative insights. Additionally, they reinforce Gartner’s value every day by engaging clients via in-person and virtual meetings, sales support visits, Gartner conferences and industry events. This role is an opportunity to join Gartner’s growing Human Resources Practice. This group is dedicated to tracking the transformation of the HR function — evolution of the HR functional structure, HR roles, and HR technology strategy — and advising Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) and other HR functional leaders. Senior Directors are expected to offer flexibility in what they can cover and how they channel their expertise.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have” insights offering compelling, objective and actionable advice for Gartner clients in multiple formats (i.e., writing, video, infographics, podcasts) on topics including (but not limited to) focusing on HR functional transformation, HR strategic planning, and HR technology strategy and use cases.
* Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act.
* Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
* Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing insights positions across a team of analysts
* Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
* Deliver individualized advice rooted in quantitative and qualitative data and specific to a client role to CHROs and other senior HR leaders through video-based presentations and discussions
* Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
* Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
* Provide high quality and timely content peer review
* Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
* Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
* Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
* Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
* Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

**What you will need:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
* 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience in HR functional and/or HR technology leadership roles or an equivalent combination of education and experience; with the below subject matter expertise:

+ Profound understanding of the challenges CHROs face as leaders within the enterprise and familiarity with the CHRO workflows and priorities
+ Experience successfully designing and leading HR functional transformations.
+ Knowledge of the HR technology landscape, including market dynamics and vendors, particularly with respect to AI, and their impact on HR strategies and workflows.

* Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
* Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
* Strong communicator who is able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
* Subject matter expert comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements
* Strong business and financial acumen
* Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
* Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
* Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

* Develop on-demand content for orientation and key learning modules

* Partner with trainers and facilitators to update learning materials and presentation decks
* Maintain and update decks on the Global PD repository
* Attend Global PD community of practice calls and support follow-up actions where required
* Ensure learning materials and communications are accurate, updated and aligned globally

Performance Review Cycles

* Support calibration sessions and consolidate review outcomes for leadership
* Track completion rates and follow up with managers and employees on outstanding reviews
* Maintain performance review documentation and ensure data accuracy in HR systems
* Partner with the Learning and Inclusion Manager to translate review outcomes into development priorities

Talent Projects & Operations
  
  

* Support execution of Australia talent projects, including recruitment funnel tracking and reporting
* Support delivery of promotion and career progression processes
* Assist with ad-hoc talent initiatives such as engagement surveys and retention analysis

**Other Strategic Projects**

* Drive key strategic initiatives in support of the Australia practice's growth strategy
* Coordinate and support execution of regional PD projects and new learning program launches
* Contribute to continuous improvement of learning processes and participant experience
* Support the broader Talent team on other initiatives and business-as-usual activity

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Liaise with internal stakeholders including HRBPs, consulting leadership and program facilitators
* Support smooth delivery of learning sessions across multiple offices and time zones
* Build strong working relationships across the Australia leadership team
* Support ad-hoc people initiatives and special projects as required

**Candidate Requirements**

* Strong facilitation and content design skills, with the ability to lead learning sessions independently
* Excellent organisational and co-ordination skills with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders across regions
* Proactive, collaborative and solutions-oriented mindset
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced consulting environment
* Strong operational discipline and execution capability
* Genuine interest in learning and development, and people strategy
* Experience supporting performance review cycles, talent operations or broader people operations processes
* Sound understanding of HR and talent operations practices, including data management and reporting

**Candidate Qualifications**

* Masters degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Organisational Development or a related field
* 5-7 years of experience in Learning & Development, HR Operations or people coordination roles, including content design and facilitation
* Prior experience designing and delivering learning programs, training operations or employee engagement initiatives
* Experience within professional services, consulting or a fast-paced corporate environment preferred
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook
* Experience managing training logistics, communications and stakeholder coordination
* Familiarity with learning platforms, survey tools or HR systems is an advantage
* Experience working across regional or multicultural teams, ideally supporting Australia or APAC, preferred
* 4+ years of experience in People or Talent Operations, performance management or HR operations, in addition to L&D experience
* Prior experience supporting performance review cycles, talent projects or workforce reporting in a professional services or corporate environment

**Benefits And Perks Offered**

title: Director
description:
**About The Company**

At Dawn Technologies is a niche company laser-focused on delivering specialised tech solutions in Gen AI, Data Engineering,and Backend Systems. What sets us apart is our commitment to the technologists — the creators, problem-solvers, and innovators who bring true value to transformation. We believe that teamwork plus talent equals exceptional results. We are looking for teammates who are great problem solvers and enjoy collaborating within a team to achieve big outcomes.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a senior HR operations and transformation leader to join At Dawn permanently and build our HR transformation capability. Your first assignment will be a multi-year HR transformation programme for a large global enterprise client operating across many countries. The client is reimagining its core HR processes for an agentic world: reducing localisation, removing redundant steps, and using AI agents and orchestration where they genuinely add value, while keeping core HR systems central.

As Director, HR Transformation, you will be the senior HR voice of our team and lead our HR transformation offering. You will work alongside our journey-engineering and AI architecture leads and the client's Global Process Owners to redesign employee-lifecycle journeys end to end, then turn those designs into requirements that the client's technology teams can build. This is a senior, hands-on design role, not an advisory one: you will run workshops, make recommendations and own design outputs.

**Location -**
India (Gurugram / Bengaluru / Mumbai) or UK, hybrid, with strong overlap with UK working hours and periodic travel

**Key Responsibilities**

**Programme set-up and design authority**

Co-lead the HR process design authority alongside the client's Global Process Owners, driving timely, well-documented design decisions.

Help establish the transformation roadmap, phasing and design principles for a multi-year, multi-country HR programme.

Shape the future BAU operating model and governance for HR operations in an agentic (AI-enabled) environment, including the role of global capability centres and regional hubs.

**Process re-imagination**

Lead end-to-end redesign of employee-lifecycle journeys: job change and transfers, new hire and onboarding administration, leavers, absence, time and attendance, employee data and Tier 1 query management.

Map current-state processes with HR operations, HRBPs, Comp & Benefits and managers across countries; diagnose friction and gaps; separate legal requirements from policy choices.

Design a global core with country variations held as parameters and rules, and drive standardisation decisions with process owners.

Decide, step by step, what should be eliminated, standardised, configured in core HR systems, automated, given to an AI agent or kept with a human.

title: Senior Analyst - Payroll
description:
We are looking for a Senior Payroll Analyst to carry out the end-to-end payroll process and delivery, including taxation and payroll related statutory compliance under labour laws at Rio Tinto office in Gurgaon, India.
  
  
This role is a great opportunity for an experienced payroll professional to work as part of a team to deliver effective and efficient payroll services, provide continuous improvement ideas, and monitor governance and delivery of the payroll provider. As a key point of contact, the role will liaise with internal Rio Tinto partners as well as external parties to deliver the end-to-end payroll. Working and reporting to the Advisor Payroll India, you will be
  
  

* Responsible for delivering the day-to-day activities of the payroll services and statutory payroll compliance on behalf of the business.
* Effectively manage critical cut-off dates for payroll and related processes
* Ensure compliance with company policies, internal control standards and regulatory requirements
* Resolving queries either within payroll services or with external parties which may include technical issues or complex payroll queries.
* Maintaining a focus on continuous improvement to identify and implement improvement opportunities in the payroll process and technical solution. Ensuring global consistency of processes and procedures.
* Understanding the payroll related requirements and to act as a point of contact for stakeholders in relation to new functionality, ad hoc requirements or system changes

**About You**

* A Bachelors degree or other suitable business related qualification or appropriate Payroll experience
* 6-8 years of experience working on Payroll system (including taxation) and Labour law related compliances
* Knowledge of HR policies and procedures working in a MNC or Payroll service provider
* Payroll SAP knowledge desirable
* Excellent organization, written/ verbal communication and presentation skills
* Strong technical skills in Microsoft Office products coupled with strong analytical skills

* Payroll experience having 6-8 yrs exp.

We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are essential to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation or anything else that makes us different.

title: Senior Human Resource Business Partner
description:
**About Voy**
Voy is one of the largest DTC online healthcare providers in the world. Present in the UK, Germany, Brazil and India. Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. EarlyFit started as India’s first full-stack tech-led GLP-1 led weight loss platform. At the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer technology, we combined GLP 1, medical expertise, endocrinologist-led care, diagnostics, nutrition coaching, and ongoing behavioral support into one seamless experience.
  
  
**About The Space**
GLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also…) means there is a unique opportunity to category create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 bringing monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs 3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.
  
  
**What You'll Do ?**

* Partner with business leaders on people, talent & workforce strategy.
* Drive performance, engagement, succession & leadership development.
* Use people data to turn insights into action.
* Coach leaders through change, growth & complex people matters.
* Build a culture where people and business thrive together.

**What you bring ?**

* 8+ years of progressive HR/HRBP experience.
* Strong business acumen and stakeholder management skills.
* Expertise in talent, performance, engagement & organizational development.
* A curious mind, commercial thinking, and the courage to ask the uncomfortable questions.

title: HR (Associate) Director, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description:
**About The AI Access Initiative**
We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.
  
  
Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.
  
  

* Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change.
* Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions.

We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.
  
  
**About 2AI India And EAII Advisors**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
The HR Lead's primary mandate is establishing the cultural foundation and talent engine that sustains quality through rapid growth. This is strategic, high-leverage work: designing the onboarding experience, the ways of working, and the early culture infrastructure that will shape how 2AI India operates as it scales, and finding and retaining the talent that will deliver on 2AI's mission.
  
  
Entity compliance and HR systems are real responsibilities, but they can be supported by the Chief of Staff or through external partners and retained recruiters while the organization is small. This is a founding member of the leadership team, setting the tone for leadership and management expectation as well as modeling values alignment across the organization.
  
  
*Culture Design and Stewardship*

* Designs and owns the founding culture infrastructure for 2AI India: the ways of working, the norms, and the recurring moments that reinforce them
* Thinks carefully about what founding culture means here and is accountable for getting it right, understanding that early culture is disproportionately hard to change later
* Builds a culture that connects meaningfully to the broader global 2AI organization, not only to the India office
* Maintains culture through growth, which is a different problem from establishing it

*Talent Strategy*

* Brings strong but adaptable perspectives on staff resourcing in a dynamic growth stage; advises on team structure, hiring needs, and sequencing
* Designs an onboarding experience that connects new hires to the mission, to each other, and to what great performance looks like in this organization

*Talent Sourcing and Assessment*

* Attracts talent who may not apply through standard channels, and builds warm pipelines before the roles are open
* Manages part-time or consultant recruiters now and brings on full-time recruiting capacity as hiring accelerates
* Designs structured hiring processes with consistent, criteria-based assessment, including for the culture attributes that matter as much as technical fit
* Coaches hiring managers to be good interviewers who give calibrated feedback and decide efficiently

*Talent Density and Performance*

* Builds a picture of who is performing at or above expectations, who is developing, and who is at risk, and helps managers act on it
* Coaches leaders through underperformance situations with accountability to the mission and care for the individual

*HR Systems and Compliance*

* Understands the HR infrastructure needs of a rapidly growing organization and builds right-sized systems to meet them
* Manages compliance and employment obligations, working with EAII, 3rd party payroll, or other external partners where appropriate, without letting it become the core job
* Uses data to inform people decisions, including headcount, hiring velocity, attrition, and compensation equity

*Strategic Thought Partnership*

* Advises on people decisions including hiring, team structure, or difficult personnel situations
* Handles sensitive situations with discretion and judgment, and knows when to escalate, resolve directly, or bring in external expertise

Disclaimer: The duties and responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list and additional tasks may be assigned to the employee from time to time.
  
  
**Requirements**
***Essentials:***

* Relevant professional background: 10-12 years in HR, people operations, or talent roles, with meaningful time in organizations where you had to build rather than inherit
* Culture building: has built and maintained a strong, positive team or organizational culture, and has done so during a period of growth rather than in steady state
* Global orientation: has worked with or within a globally distributed team, and understands the practical dynamics of time zones, cultural difference in feedback, and connecting a country office to a global organization
* Talent acquisition: full-cycle recruiting experience including sourcing and closing senior hires in competitive or thin talent markets, through non-traditional channels rather than job boards alone
* Assessment instincts: strong judgment on fit beyond credentials, and the discipline to build structured processes rather than relying on that judgment alone
* Onboarding and development: has designed onboarding or development experiences that measurably changed how new hires performed, and can describe what worked and what did not
* Systems building: has judgment about what HR infrastructure an organization of this size actually needs, the restraint not to build for a size it is not yet, and an eye for how a new process will land on the people using it
* Compliance literacy: understands Indian employment and HR compliance requirements well enough to manage them through external partners, and knows when to call for expert input
* Discretion: exercises judgment with confidential material and does not let a difficult situation sit because it is uncomfortable
* Data-driven: strong analytical instincts. Builds the tools and runs the analysis themselves rather than waiting for a dedicated analyst
* Self-awareness: humility, low ego, no task too small, and the ability to see other perspectives and acknowledge blind spots
* AI-forward: curious and experimental with AI tools, including in sourcing, assessment, and people processes, with judgment about where they help and where they do not
* Comfort with ambiguity: thrives in high-growth scenarios and is comfortable with shifting timelines and priorities

**What Success Looks Like**
In the First 6 Months:

title: Talent Insights Manager - Global Businesses & Functions
description:
**Locations**
: Gurgaon | London
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Talent Insights Manager, you will help our Global Businesses & Functions (GBF) build a more integrated and forward-looking understanding of our existing workforce and talent and translate that intelligence into better talent and workforce decisions. You will bring together internal data on workforce composition, roles, competencies, hiring, compensation, performance, potential, career progression, and retention with external intelligence on labor-market dynamics, emerging skills, talent scarcity, and market compensation.
  
  
Your focus will be on connecting these signals, not simply reporting them, to identify emerging talent and capability risks and translate them into strategic guidance. You will help leaders understand where critical talent sits today, where internal or external trends may create future risks, and where BCG may need to adjust how we attract, recognize, reward, and retain the talent and capabilities most important to our future.
  
  
You will also help advance our analytics maturity over time, moving from primarily historical reporting toward stronger leading indicators, scenario analysis, and increasingly forward-looking workforce insights and decision support.
  
  
**Key Activities**

* Support the continued development of BCG’s workforce reporting and analytics, improving the consistency, quality, and usefulness of existing HR metrics while identifying opportunities to simplify and automate recurring analysis.
* Analyze workforce data including headcount, roles, competencies, hiring, performance, potential, promotions, and attrition to identify trends and areas requiring further investigation.
* Compare talent data across employee populations to identify patterns in hiring, performance, progression, retention, and other workforce outcomes.
* Combine compensation data with performance, potential, career progression, talent scarcity, and available market benchmarks to help assess how effectively BCG is recognizing and retaining key talent and identify where compensation actions may warrant consideration.
* Incorporate external labor-market data to provide context on talent availability, emerging skills, hiring demand, compensation, and areas where critical talent may be harder to attract or retain.
* Build on historical reporting by testing new metrics and leading indicators that can provide earlier visibility into emerging workforce trends and risks and develop scenario analyses that help leaders understand the potential implications of different workforce and talent choices.
* Leverage AI and emerging analytical tools to accelerate analysis, identify patterns and anomalies, test hypotheses, and explore new ways to make workforce insights more scalable and actionable.
* Prepare analyses, dashboards, decision-support tools, and leadership materials that clearly explain findings, supporting data, and areas that may warrant action or further analysis.
* Maintain accuracy and consistency across complex datasets while connecting detailed findings to broader business questions and applying appropriate judgment to the interpretation and use of data and AI-generated insights.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 6–8 years of experience in analytics, HR, workforce planning, talent, consulting, or related roles, with experience using data to inform business decisions.
* Bachelor’s degree with experience working with complex workforce, talent, or business data.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to connect detailed data and metrics to broader workforce and business questions and develop and test hypotheses.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and Power BI, plus demonstrated ability to use GenAI and other analytical tools to support analysis and problem solving.
* Experience combining and interpreting data from multiple sources to identify trends, relationships, and anomalies, and areas requiring further investigation.
* Experience translating complex analyses into clear, structured materials and insights for senior leadership, including implications and potential areas for action.
* Strong attention to detail and organization, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and data integrity.

The following experience would be beneficial but is not required:
  
  

* Experience with workforce planning, compensation, talent analytics, or external labor-market intelligence.
* Experience with scenario analysis, forecasting, or other forward-looking analytical approaches.
* Experience using AI, automation, or other technology to simplify or scale recurring analytical work.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will be part of our Global Businesses & Function HR team, sitting within the Talent Insights & Compensation team. This team brings together workforce, talent, compensation, and external market information to help our businesses and functions better understand their talent and inform people decisions.
  
  
You will work across BCG’s global corporate functions and businesses, partnering with HR and business leaders and teams to understand their workforce questions and translate available data into meaningful insights. You will also collaborate with colleagues across talent, compensation, recruiting, and other HR teams to connect different perspectives and provide a more complete view of our workforce and talent.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Human Resources & Talent Acquisition

**Reporting to:**
Founders / Leadership Team

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, Work from Office

About Darwix AI

Darwix AI is a growing enterprise AI company building physical-first Agentic AI solutions for complex business workflows, particularly in BFSI.

Our technology combines Voice AI Agents, Sherpa AI, Real-Time Agent Assist, Document Intelligence, QA and Compliance Intelligence, and an agentic orchestration layer to help enterprises translate real-world conversations into structured intelligence and governed actions.

With 50+ enterprise relationships across six geographies, we are building a team capable of solving meaningful AI and business challenges at scale.

We are looking for a highly energetic, resourceful, technology-oriented HR professional who wants to help build that team.

The Opportunity

This is not a conventional HR coordination position.

We are looking for someone who enjoys finding exceptional people, engaging with prospective candidates, understanding their capabilities, convincing them to explore opportunities, and driving hiring processes to closure.

You will be responsible for building recruitment pipelines for technical, product, AI, sales, business and operations positions while simultaneously supporting end-to-end HR operations.

You should be comfortable using LinkedIn, professional databases, hiring platforms, AI tools, campus networks and unconventional sourcing techniques.

You will work closely with the founders and hiring managers, gaining exposure to how a rapidly growing enterprise AI business hires and operates.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Recruitment Ownership

* Understand hiring requirements directly from founders and functional heads.
* Translate requirements into clear JDs, ideal candidate profiles and screening criteria.
* Independently source, shortlist, engage and evaluate suitable candidates.
* Conduct initial HR screening and qualification calls.
* Evaluate experience, communication, motivation, compensation expectations, availability and role alignment.
* Coordinate technical, functional and leadership interviews.
* Maintain candidate engagement throughout the selection process.
* Own follow-ups, offer discussions, negotiation and joining coordination.
* Build backup pipelines for critical positions.
* Track recruitment progress against agreed hiring priorities.

2. AI, Engineering and Product Hiring

A significant part of this role involves recruiting for technology and product positions.

You should develop a functional understanding of profiles such as:

* AI/ML Engineers
* Generative AI and LLM Engineers
* Python / Backend Engineers
* Full-Stack Developers
* AI Product Managers
* Product Analysts
* Data Scientists and Analysts
* AI Implementation and Solutions Engineers
* Technical interns and graduate trainees

You are not expected to be a software engineer. However, you should be willing to learn enough about technical terminology and candidate backgrounds to distinguish credible profiles from keyword-heavy resumes.

Develop familiarity with Python, APIs, LLMs, RAG, model evaluation, AI workflows and software development fundamentals.

Work with technical hiring managers to understand essential skills, project depth and interview evaluation criteria.

3. Sales, Growth and Business Hiring

Support recruitment for:

* Enterprise Sales
* B2B and SaaS Sales
* Business Development
* SDR / BDR
* Customer Success
* Account Management
* Implementation and Client Delivery
* Growth and Marketing
* Business Operations

Assess candidates for commercial awareness, communication, enterprise selling exposure, target ownership, stakeholder management and ability to operate in a startup environment.

4. LinkedIn and Multi-Channel Sourcing

Develop consistent, high-quality sourcing capabilities across:

* LinkedIn and LinkedIn Recruiter
* Naukri, Instahyre, Indeed, Wellfound and Cutshort
* GitHub and relevant technical communities
* College placement networks and alumni groups
* Employee referrals
* Professional communities
* Existing resume databases
* Targeted outreach and candidate referrals

Key activities include:

* Boolean and X-ray search.
* Competitor and target-company talent mapping.
* Identifying passive candidates.
* Creating personalized recruitment messages.
* Building reusable candidate pipelines.
* Re-engaging suitable candidates from previous hiring processes.
* Measuring sourcing-channel effectiveness.

We are especially interested in candidates who enjoy finding talent rather than simply waiting for job applications.

5. AI-Enabled Recruitment

You should be enthusiastic about applying modern AI tools to recruitment and HR workflows.

Examples include:

* Using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar tools to help create JDs.
* Generating structured screening questions.
* Extracting job-relevant information from resumes using approved tools.
* Creating consistent candidate evaluation summaries.
* Personalizing sourcing messages.
* Preparing interview scorecards.
* Consolidating interview feedback.
* Identifying recruitment pipeline bottlenecks.
* Building hiring reports and dashboards.
* Automating repetitive administrative activities.

You must verify AI-generated outputs, protect candidate information and ensure recruitment decisions receive appropriate human review.

6. Campus Recruitment and University Partnerships

Build relationships with placement cells and talent teams across universities and colleges.

Responsibilities include:

* Identifying campuses relevant to AI, engineering, product and business hiring.
* Coordinating internships and graduate hiring opportunities.
* Managing communication with placement officers.
* Organizing assessments, hiring drives and interviews.
* Maintaining a database of college relationships.
* Creating structured internship-to-employment pipelines.
* Managing joining and documentation for campus hires.

7. Salary Negotiation and Offer Closure

Own candidate conversations across the offer stage, including:

* Understanding current compensation and candidate expectations.
* Evaluating fixed versus variable compensation structures.
* Working within approved salary budgets.
* Managing competing-offer situations.
* Communicating compensation and employment terms accurately.
* Negotiating professionally without making unauthorized commitments.
* Issuing and coordinating offer documentation.
* Managing offer acceptance and notice-period engagement.
* Minimizing offer-to-joining drop-offs.

We value candidates who can balance employee expectations, business economics and relationship management.

8. HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle

Support smooth day-to-day HR operations, including:

**Pre-joining and onboarding**

* Documentation and joining formalities.
* Employee database creation.
* Offer and employment records.
* Induction and onboarding coordination.
* IT, administration and reporting-manager coordination.

**Employee operations**

* Attendance and leave administration.
* Payroll-input coordination with finance.
* Maintaining accurate employee records.
* HR policies and internal communication.
* Employee query resolution.
* Probation review coordination.
* Employee engagement activities.
* Tracking important employee lifecycle milestones.

**Exit management**

* Exit formalities.
* Asset and document handovers.
* Clearance coordination.
* Employee record updates.
* Exit feedback administration.

Maintain confidentiality and professional handling of employee information.

9. Recruitment Analytics and Founder Reporting

Maintain accurate, frequently updated hiring trackers.

You should be comfortable reporting on:

* Open positions and priority vacancies.
* Candidates sourced and contacted.
* Response and screening conversion rates.
* Shortlists submitted.
* Interview progress.
* Interview-to-offer conversion.
* Offer acceptance and joining rates.
* Recruitment turnaround time.
* Sourcing-channel productivity.
* Campus hiring progress.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong verbal and written English communication.
* Confidence in professional outreach and candidate conversations.
* Interest in technology, AI and enterprise business.
* Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn.
* Ability to conduct structured research.
* Attention to detail and disciplined follow-up.
* Basic spreadsheet and data-management capabilities.
* Ability to coordinate multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Professional judgment and confidentiality.
* Comfortable using modern productivity and AI tools.
* Ability to independently execute tasks and take ownership.
* Strong willingness to learn and adapt.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR, Business Administration, Management, Commerce, Psychology or a related discipline.
* 0–2 years of experience in recruitment, HR operations, talent acquisition, internships or campus placement activities.
* Prior exposure to startup recruitment, IT hiring, SaaS hiring or technical talent sourcing is advantageous.
* Experience conducting LinkedIn sourcing or initial candidate screening is desirable.
* Freshers with demonstrable recruitment projects, internships or strong sourcing capabilities are welcome.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

Someone who:

* Enjoys speaking to new people and building professional relationships.
* Is persistent without being unnecessarily aggressive.
* Can move comfortably between AI engineering and sales hiring requirements.
* Enjoys discovering and experimenting with new technology.
* Takes ownership instead of waiting for repeated instructions.
* Understands that hiring success requires both quality and speed.
* Is organized enough to manage several parallel hiring journeys.
* Is comfortable working closely with founders.
* Wants to build a meaningful long-term career in talent acquisition and HR.

Working Arrangements

This is a full-time, work-from-office position.

**Office:**
Imperia Mindspace, Sector 62, Gurugram, Haryana.

**Office hours:**
10:45 AM to 8:00 PM.

**Working schedule:**
Monday to Friday, with alternate Saturdays working.

description:
**We're Hiring for Intralink – A Global Business Development Consultancy** 




  





 We are excited to be recruiting on behalf of Intralink, an international business development and innovation consultancy that specializes in helping companies expand into global markets. With over 36 years of experience and a presence in more than 28 locations across Asia, Europe, and North America, Intralink partners with startups, scaleups, multinationals, and government agencies to drive international growth, innovation, and sustainability.
 



  





 Intralink has been recognized with prestigious awards, including the UK's King's Award for Enterprise and the US President's E Award, for its exceptional work in facilitating international business expansion.
 



  





**Finance \& HR Manager, Intralink India** 




**Background** 




 Are you someone who enjoys bringing structure, clarity and financial discipline to a fast\-moving, international work environment?
 



  





 Do you thrive at the intersection of finance and people operations?
 



  





 And, do you want to play a pivotal role in supporting a globally connected consulting firm as it grows its footprint in India?
 



  





 If that’s yes, yes and yes, you may be who we are looking for to join our team.
 



  





 Intralink is a global business development consultancy specialising in international markets. With over 25 offices worldwide and more than 200 multilingual professionals, we support companies across technology, industrial, consumer and sustainability\-driven sectors to expand internationally.
 



  





 As we continue to grow our India presence, we are looking for a Finance \& HR Manager to take ownership of the India office’s financial operations, HR administration and broader office management. You’ll report directly to the India Managing Director and work closely with our UK headquarters, playing a trusted role in ensuring smooth, compliant and efficient operations on the ground.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing** 




 You’ll be responsible for managing the financial health and HR operations of Intralink’s India office.
 



 Acting as a key point of contact between local operations and UK headquarters, you’ll ensure robust financial controls, accurate reporting, and seamless coordination with external partners.
 



  





**Accounting \& Finance** 




 In your day\-to\-day, you’ll manage daily bank operations, oversee staff expense claims and reimbursements, and monitor expenditure against approved budgets. You’ll prepare and report monthly management accounts to headquarters, support annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting, and provide sound financial advice to the India Managing Director.
 



  





 You’ll coordinate closely with vendors, external accountants and auditors on GST, manage corporate income tax filings and statutory audits, assist in implementing standard accounting policies, and ensure all financial records are properly maintained. You’ll also manage locally issued client invoices, credit control processes, and staff severance and pension arrangements where applicable.
 



  





**HR \& Payroll Support** 




 You’ll support core HR operations including payroll processing, withholding tax filings and year\-end tax settlements. This will include assisting with staff onboarding and offboarding, benefits enrolment, annual health insurance renewals and responding to employee queries related to salaries and administrative matters.
 



  





 You’ll maintain accurate personnel and leave records, support recruitment\-related logistics such as interviews or job fairs when required, provide documentation for staff visas, and organise mandatory annual training or health check\-ups. Ensuring HR compliance and supporting ad\-hoc people\-related initiatives will also form part of your role.
 



  





 You’ll also stay aware of changes to Indian labour laws to ensure ongoing compliance and help organise board meetings on a quarterly basis.
 



  





**What you’ll be getting** 




 ● Competitive and negotiable salary, depending on experience
 



 ● 20 days of paid annual leave per year
 



 ● Health insurance coverage
 



 ● A multinational working environment with close collaboration across global offices
 



 ● Exposure to international business operations and senior stakeholders
 



 ● A trusted, high\-impact role supporting leadership and business growth in India
 



  





**What you’ll need** 




 • 5\+ years of relevant work experience in accounting or finance, strongly preferred
 



 • Hands\-on experience with accounting systems (NetSuite experience highly desirable)
 



 • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls and administrative procedures
 



 • Solid understanding of office management systems and HR administration
 



 • Excellent organisational, planning and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail
 



 • Ability to prioritise effectively and work independently in a fast\-paced environment
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
 



 • Advanced spoken and written English skills
 



 • Native or fluent Hindi
 



  





 This position is based in India and will require regular interaction with Intralink’s UK headquarters and local stakeholders.
 



 Please submit a CV and Cover Letter detailing your experience and motivations for applying to this role.

title: Corporate Relations Intern– Industry Partnerships & Placements
description:
**Company:** 

 DIYguru Mobility Pvt. Ltd.
 




**Industry:** 

 Electric Vehicles (EV), Mobility \& Skill Development
 




**Department:** 

 Corporate Relations \& Placements
 




**Location:** 

 Delhi – Sultanpur / Noida
 




**Employment Type:** 

 Internship
 




**Education:** 

 MBA/PGDM preferred; graduates from Operations, Marketing, HR, Engineering or related backgrounds may apply.
 




**Duration:** 

 6 Months internship for fresher /Full time for experienced candidates 
 




  





**About DIYguru** 




  






 DIYguru is India’s leading platform for
 
**upskilling students and professionals in Electric Vehicles (EV) and future mobility** 

 . We are focused on bridging the industry skill gap through
 
**hands\-on, industry\-relevant learning experiences** 

 that prepare individuals for emerging career opportunities across EV, battery technology, automotive electronics, connected mobility and sustainable transportation.
 





 Through our industry\-focused programs, corporate partnerships, placement initiatives and practical learning ecosystem, DIYguru connects
 
**education, industry and employment** 

 to build a future\-ready workforce for the rapidly evolving mobility sector.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




  






 We are looking for an energetic, organized and communication\-focused Corporate Relations Intern to support our corporate relations, placement and industry partnership activities.
 





 This role is ideal for a fresher who wants practical exposure to Corporate Relations, HR, Business Development, Industry Partnerships and Placement Management. You will work directly on company research, lead generation, corporate outreach, hiring coordination, candidate mapping and relationship management.
 





 The role involves regular communication with HR professionals, recruiters, hiring managers, colleges and candidates, making it a strong opportunity for someone who enjoys networking, research, follow\-ups and building professional relationships.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Corporate Research \& Lead Generation** 



* Research companies hiring across EV, automotive, manufacturing, engineering, software, electronics, battery, mobility and related sectors.
* Identify HR, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment and relevant business POCs.
* Build and maintain a structured corporate database.
* Identify companies suitable for DIYguru's placement and hiring ecosystem.
* Research company hiring patterns, locations, job roles and manpower requirements.
* Generate new corporate leads through LinkedIn, company career pages, industry networks and referrals



  





**2\. Corporate Outreach \& Follow\-ups** 



* Contact HRs, recruiters and hiring managers through email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and calls.
* Introduce DIYguru's training, placement and industry ecosystem.
* Understand corporate manpower requirements and hiring needs.
* Schedule meetings with relevant corporate stakeholders.
* Conduct timely and professional follow\-ups with prospects.
* Maintain an updated status for every corporate lead.



  





**3\. Placement \& Hiring Coordination** 



* Collect and understand Job Descriptions received from companies.
* Support candidate mapping against company requirements.
* Coordinate resume/profile sharing with corporate partners.
* Support interviews, assessments and hiring drives.
* Maintain interview schedules and candidate status.
* Follow up with candidates and companies until the hiring process is completed.
* Support OJT, internship, placement drives and Recruitathons.



  





**4\. Employer \& Industry Relationship Support** 



* Maintain professional relationships with HRs and recruiters.
* Capture and communicate company feedback to the internal team.
* Track repeat hiring opportunities from existing corporate relationships.
* Identify opportunities for long\-term corporate partnerships and MoUs.
* Support the Corporate Relations team in building a strong employer network.



  





**5\. College \& Placement Cell Outreach** 



* Research colleges, universities, ITIs, diploma institutions and engineering institutes.
* Identify TPOs, placement officers, HODs and relevant institutional contacts.
* Support outreach for placement collaborations, hiring drives, Recruitathons and industry programs.
* Build and maintain college databases and communication records.



  





**6\. MIS, CRM \& Documentation** 



* Maintain corporate, candidate and college databases.
* Update lead status, follow\-up dates, requirements and outcomes.
* Prepare daily and weekly MIS reports.
* Track pending follow\-ups and ensure leads are not missed.
* Maintain accurate records of corporate requirements, candidate mapping and hiring activities.



  





**7\. Required Qualifications** 



* Graduate in HR, Marketing, Management, Engineering or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM is preferred.
* Freshers and candidates seeking internship experience are encouraged to apply.
* **Strong interest in Corporate Relations, HR, Recruitment or the EV industry.**



  





**Must\-Have Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Confidence in speaking with HRs and professionals
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building ability
* Research and lead\-generation skills
* Good LinkedIn usage and professional networking ability
* Professional email and WhatsApp communication
* Basic Excel/Google Sheets knowledge
* Strong organization and time\-management skills
* Willingness to make professional calls
* Ability to handle rejection positively



  





**Good\-to\-Have Skills** 



* Prior internship in HR, Sales or Corporate Relations
* Experience with CRM or lead\-management tools
* Understanding of recruitment and placement processes
* Knowledge of the EV, automotive or mobility industry
* Basic understanding of LinkedIn prospecting



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




  






 The ideal candidate is proactive, confident, curious and comfortable communicating with new people. You should be willing to pick up the phone, conduct research, send professional messages, follow up consistently and take ownership of assigned leads.
 





 You should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change and results depend on consistent execution. Most importantly, we are looking for someone with a learning mindset, professional attitude, accountability and genuine interest in building an industry network.
 




  





**Key Performance Expectations** 



* Build and continuously update a high\-quality corporate prospect database.
* Generate and qualify relevant corporate leads on a regular basis.
* Maintain consistent follow\-ups and accurate lead\-status tracking.
* Support timely candidate mapping and hiring coordination against company JDs.
* Maintain professional communication with corporate and institutional stakeholders.
* Contribute to developing new corporate and institutional relationships for DIYguru.



  





**Why Join DIYguru?** 



* EV \& Future Mobility Exposure: Work closely with companies and professionals across the growing EV and mobility ecosystem.
* Industry\-Focused Learning: Gain practical exposure to corporate hiring, placements and industry partnerships.
* Real Corporate Projects: Work on live company requirements, hiring drives, Recruitathons and partnership initiatives.
* Cross\-Functional Exposure: Learn how HR, Business Development, Corporate Relations and Placement functions work together.
* Career Growth: Build practical skills and professional networks that can support a long\-term career in Corporate Relations, HR, Recruitment or Business Development.



  





**Application Process** 





 Interested candidates can apply by sharing their updated resume at
 
 hr@diyguru.org
 






 Candidates should highlight relevant internships, projects, communication experience, activities, HR exposure or professional networking experience.
 





 Join DIYguru and gain hands\-on experience at the intersection of EV, industry, education and employment.

 Gurugram \|

 On\-site \|

 Full\-time
 



  





 We’re looking for a
 **People \& Culture Associate** 
 to join our growing team and take ownership of core people processes across the employee lifecycle.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **People \& Culture Associate** 
 to own and execute core people processes across the employee lifecycle. The role will work closely with the founder to build scalable people practices across hiring, onboarding, HR operations, performance management, employee documentation, and statutory compliance.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, taking ownership of processes from the ground up, and balancing people\-centric thinking with strong execution and attention to detail.

* Manage core HR operations across the employee lifecycle, from joining to exit.

 .

* Identify and resolve compliance gaps across the employee lifecycle.

title: SENIOR MANAGER – HUMAN RESOURCES  & PEOPLE OPERATIONS
description:
**Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| 4–6 Years Experience**




 We are looking for a sharp, ambitious and highly dependable 
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations** 
  to establish and run the core HR operating systems of our Delhi NCR headquarters.
 



 This is a broad, hands\-on management mandate covering 
 **recruitment, payroll management, employee lifecycle, HR systems, international personnel administration, work\-authorisation coordination, performance processes, HR compliance, employee records and management reporting** 
 .
 



 The person joining us will not simply inherit an existing HR desk. They will help build a disciplined and scalable People Operations function capable of supporting a growing Indian and international workforce.
   





 The Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations will be responsible for establishing and operating the 
 **Delhi HQ HR infrastructure** 
  and ensuring that employee administration is accurate, controlled, responsive and scalable.
 



 The role will include:
 


1. Establishing the core 
 **HR operating framework for the Delhi NCR headquarters** 
 , including HRIS, employee master data, personnel files, joining systems, attendance, leave, payroll controls, probation, performance\-cycle administration and separation processes.
2. Managing 
 **end\-to\-end payroll administration and payroll coordination** 
 , including monthly employee data, attendance and leave inputs, salary changes, approved deductions, reimbursements, variable\-pay inputs, new joiners, exits and payroll reconciliation.
3. Working with Finance, payroll vendors and management to ensure that payroll records reconcile with approved employment terms and employee master data.
4. Maintaining payroll calendars, change\-control records, salary/CTC documentation and payroll exception trackers.
5. Coordinating statutory and employee\-related payroll documentation with the appropriate Finance, Legal, payroll and professional advisers.
6. Managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple concurrent managerial, specialist, technical and administrative mandates.
7. Managing RPOs, recruitment agencies, LinkedIn, job portals, direct sourcing and referral channels.
8. Coordinating candidate assessment, interview scheduling, approvals, compensation discussions, offers and joining.
9. Managing BGV, references, pre\-employment documentation and controlled onboarding.
10. Creating and maintaining accurate employee records, organisation data, reporting relationships, designation/grade records and employment\-history documentation.
11. Managing attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, promotions, approved compensation changes, transfers and employee status changes.
12. Operationalising Board\- and management\-approved HR, workplace, travel, employee and administrative policies.
13. Maintaining policy acknowledgements, training evidence, compliance registers and HR audit documentation.
14. Supporting performance\-management administration, including 
 **30/60/90\-day reviews, probation reviews, confirmation documentation, performance records and management follow\-up** 
 .
15. Handling employee grievances, disciplinary documentation, difficult employee matters, resignations, handovers, separation processes and final\-clearance coordination.
16. Maintaining appropriate confidentiality and access controls for sensitive personnel and compensation data.
17. Coordinate 
 **international employee mobility** 
 , including visa/work\-authorisation, immigration, FRRO/FRO and renewal documentation through Legal/authorised advisers.
18. Maintain complete 
 **passport, visa, permit, registration and expiry controls** 
  for foreign personnel and international specialists.
19. Coordinate 
 **invitation letters, supporting documentation, relocation, accommodation and joining logistics** 
  for international employees.
20. Maintain an 
 **International Personnel \& Mobility Register** 
  covering status, expiries, pending actions and responsible owners.
21. Ensure required documentation and internal clearances are complete before international personnel commence regulated or approval\-dependent activities.
22. Support overseas deputation, travel and assignment documentation for Indian employees where required.
23. Establish and maintain the 
 **Delhi HQ HR operating system** 
 , including Employee Master, HRIS, recruitment pipeline, offers, BGV, joining, personnel files, attendance/leave and payroll controls.
24. Maintain 
 **compensation\-change, probation, confirmation, performance\-review, policy\-acknowledgement and training records** 
 .
25. Maintain 
 **grievance, disciplinary, separation, clearance, HR\-vendor and management\-MIS systems** 
 .
26. Own the 
 **HR\-side payroll process and reconciliation controls** 
  in coordination with Finance and authorised service providers.



  




 WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 
 Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:
 


* a functioning Delhi HQ HR operating system;
* complete employee master and controlled personnel files;
* recruitment dashboard covering all approved vacancies;
* functioning HRIS or controlled interim HR database;
* reliable attendance and leave administration;
* documented monthly payroll process and reconciliation controls;
* BGV and onboarding tracker;
* probation and confirmation calendar;
* approved policy implementation and acknowledgement records;
* management HR dashboard;
* international personnel / visa / work\-authorisation tracker where applicable;
* HR vendor and recruiter controls;
* defined employee joining, lifecycle and separation workflows.


 THE PERSON WE WANT
 
 We are looking for somebody who can 
 **build systems and then operate them** 
 .
 



 A strong candidate will be equally comfortable interviewing a senior candidate in the morning, resolving a payroll discrepancy before lunch, checking the documentation of an international employee in the afternoon and preparing a concise management dashboard before the day ends.
 



 That breadth is intentional.
 



 The role suits an HR professional who wants genuine ownership and institutional\-building responsibility — not somebody looking for a narrowly defined recruitment, HRBP or employee\-engagement position.
 


 Particularly valuable experience
 
 Candidates who have previously helped establish a 
 **new corporate office, regional headquarters, business unit, plant, international office or rapidly expanding operation** 
  will be particularly relevant.
 



 Exposure to any combination of the following will be valuable:
 



***HRIS implementation • Payroll management • Multi\-agency recruitment • International employees • Employment visas / mobility administration • BGV • Employee lifecycle • HR compliance • Performance administration • Office mobilisation • Regulated or industrial environments***




 This addition makes the position substantially stronger. It now reads as the 
 **person responsible for establishing the Delhi HQ People Operations infrastructure** 
 , rather than simply a Senior HR recruitment manager.
